```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Helper functions
'%!in%' <- function(x,y)!('%in%'(x,y))
zscr_from_counts <- function(input_matrix){
  #input_matrix <- gene_ct
  #input_matrix <- gene_ct[2:9] %>% as.matrix
  #matrix$gene_gene <- "gene"
  if (!is.matrix(input_matrix)) {
    print("Converting data frame-like object to matrix...")
    # Check to see if there is a column containing gene names, and convert to rownames
    # Check for multiple gene name columns
    if (length(grep("gene", colnames(input_matrix))) > 1) {
      print("Multiple potential gene name columns found. Please input a matrix object with genes as the rownames")
    }
    # If one gene name column found, convert to rownames and remove the gene name column
    else if (length(grep("gene|Gene", colnames(input_matrix))) > 0) {
      suppressWarnings(mat_rownames <- input_matrix %>% dplyr::select(grep("gene|Gene", colnames(input_matrix))) %>% pull())
      input_matrix <- input_matrix %>% dplyr::select(-grep("gene|Gene", colnames(input_matrix))) %>% as.matrix()
      rownames(input_matrix) <- mat_rownames
    }
    else {
      # Use print or stop here
      print("Gene name column not found in input. Please input a matrix object with genes as the rownames")
    }
    # Convert the matrix count values to a z-score
    t_mat <- input_matrix %>% t() %>% scale() %>% t()
  } else {
    # Check to make sure the matrix has row names
    if (is.null(rownames(input_matrix))) {
      print("Matrix provided does not have rownames. Please input a matrix object with genes as the rownames")
    }
    else {
      t_mat <- input_matrix
    }
  }
  return(t_mat)
}

# scRNA functions 
# Functions for scRNA analysis
preprocess_seurat <- function(object, nmad = 3, species = "human") {
  object <- Add_Cell_QC_Metrics(object, species = species)
  # Add log1p-transformed values for nCount, nGenes, and metadata labels for outliers
  object$log1p_nCount_RNA <- log(1+object$nCount_RNA)
  object$log1p_nFeature_RNA <- log(1+object$nFeature_RNA)

  # Create a function to calculate whether or not a cell is an outlier above a specific median absolute deviation of nCount or nFeat
  calculate_outliers <- function(seurat_object, slot, nmad){
    samp <- seurat_object[[slot]]
    samp_median <- apply(samp, 2, median)
    samp_mad <- apply(samp, 2, mad)
    outlier = (samp < samp_median - nmad*samp_mad | samp_median + nmad*samp_mad < samp)
    return(outlier)
    print(paste0(slot, " median absolute deviation: ", samp_mad))
  }

  object$log1p_nCount_outlier<- calculate_outliers(object, "log1p_nCount_RNA", nmad)
  object$log1p_nFeat_outlier <- calculate_outliers(object, "log1p_nFeature_RNA", nmad)
  object$mito_outlier <- calculate_outliers(object, "percent_mito", nmad)

  return(object)
}

plot_QC <- function(object, obj_name) {
  #object <- lib3_te
  n_ident <- object$orig.ident %>% unique() %>% length()
  varibow <- DiscretePalette_scCustomize(num_colors = n_ident, palette = "varibow")
  qc1 <- QC_Plot_UMIvsGene(seurat_object = object, low_cutoff_gene = 2500, high_cutoff_gene = 11000, low_cutoff_UMI = 500, high_cutoff_UMI = 60000, group.by = "orig.ident", colors_use = c("KO-T" = "#FF7373", "KO" = "#85CC3D", "WT-T" = "#179999", "WT" = "#8000FF")) +
    labs(title = "Genes v. Reads per Cell", x = "Unique Reads per Cell", y = "Genes per Cell") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  qc2 <- QC_Plot_GenevsFeature(seurat_object = object, feature1 = "percent_mito", low_cutoff_gene = 2500, high_cutoff_gene = 11000, high_cutoff_feature = 20, group.by = "mito_outlier") +
    labs(title = "Genes v. Mito % per Cell") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  qc2 <- qc2 + labs(color = "Mitochondrial\nExpression\nMAD outlier", x = "% Mitochondrial Genes per Cell", y = "Genes per Cell")
  r1 <- (wrap_plots(qc1, qc2, ncol = 2))
  qc3 <- QC_Plots_Genes(seurat_object = object, pt.size = 0, colors_use = varibow, plot_title = "Unique Genes per Cell")
  qc4 <- QC_Plots_UMIs(seurat_object = object, pt.size = 0, colors_use = varibow, plot_title = "Transcripts per Cell", y_axis_label = "Transcripts")
  qc5 <- QC_Plots_Mito(seurat_object = object, pt.size = 0, colors_use = varibow, plot_title = "Mitochondrial Gene\n% per Cell")
  r2 <- wrap_plots(qc3, qc4, qc5, ncol = 3)
  # png(filename = sprintf("%s/%s_QC_%s.png", plots_qc_path, obj_name, date), width = 12, height = 12, units = "in", bg = "transparent", res = 600)
  # print(wrap_plots(r1, r2, nrow = 2))
  # dev.off()
  pdf(file = sprintf("%s/%s_QC_%s.png", plots_qc_path, obj_name, date), width = 12, height = 12)
  print(wrap_plots(r1, r2, nrow = 2))
  dev.off()
  
}

filter_object <- function(object) {
  object <- subset(x = object, subset = log1p_nFeat_outlier == FALSE  & log1p_nCount_outlier == FALSE & mito_outlier == FALSE)
  return(object)
}

calcPCA <- function(object){
  # Pull the data to calculate PCA embeddings using svds d/t issues with the irlba implementation, transposing the scaled data to the correct format  
  data_mat <- as.matrix(object@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data) %>% t() 
  # Compute top 30 PCs 
  pca_result <- svds(data_mat, k = 30)
  # Format PCA outputs
  pca_embeddings <- pca_result$u
  rownames(pca_embeddings) <- colnames(object)
  colnames(pca_embeddings) <- paste0("PC_", 1:ncol(pca_embeddings))
  pca_loadings <- pca_result$v
  rownames(pca_loadings) <- rownames(object@assays$RNA@layers$scale.data)
  colnames(pca_loadings) <- paste0("PC_", 1:ncol(pca_loadings))
  
  # Insert PCA results into Seurat
  object[["pca"]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
    embeddings = pca_embeddings,
    loadings = pca_loadings,
    key = "PC_",
    assay = "RNA"
  )
return(object)
}

calc_embeddings <- function(object) {
  DefaultAssay(object) <- "RNA"
  object <- RunTSNE(object, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- RunUMAP(object, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
  object <- RunUMAP(object, dims = 1:30, umap.method = "umap-learn", densmap = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, reduction.key = "densMAP_", reduction.name = "densMAP")
  object <- FindNeighbors(object, dims = 1:30)
  object <- FindClusters(object, resolution = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2))
  return(object)
}

get_sil_score <- function(object, reduc_name = "umap", res_prepend = "RNA_", file_name, plot_name){
  obj_distmat <- object@reductions[[reduc_name]]@cell.embeddings %>% dist()
  red_res <- object@meta.data %>% colnames() %>% grep(res_prepend, . , value = TRUE)
  res_list <- matrix(nrow = 6, ncol = length(red_res)) %>% as_tibble()
  for (i in 1:length(red_res)){
    obj_clusters <- object@meta.data[[red_res[[i]]]] %>% as.integer()
    sil <- silhouette(obj_clusters, obj_distmat)
    # Add 1 to all the silhouette scores for plotting purposes (range = 0-2)
    sil[,3] <- sil[,3] + 1
    sil_sum <- summary(sil)
    ssl <- sil_sum$si.summary %>% as.list() %>% bind_rows() %>% t()
    res_list[,i] <- ssl[,1]
  }
  # Make a data frame to hold the outputs of the silhouette score calculation and write to .csv
  colnames(res_list) <- red_res
  rownames(res_list) <- c("Min.", "1st Qu.", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu.","Max.")
  write.csv(res_list, file = sprintf("%s/%s_silscore.csv", outputs_path, file_name))
  # Mung the data to tidy format and plot as geom_boxplot
  rn_to_cn <- rownames_to_column(res_list, var = "Variable")
  tidy_df <- gather(rn_to_cn, key = "snn_res", value = "Value", -Variable)
  bp1 <- ggplot(tidy_df, aes(x = snn_res, y = Value, fill = snn_res)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = "snn_res", y = "Silhouette score + 1", title = sprintf("Silhouette Scores of %s densMAP clusters", plot_name)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  png(filename = sprintf("%s/%s_silhouette_score_boxplot_%s.png", plots_qc_path, file_name, date), width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", bg = "white", res = 600)
  print(bp1)
  dev.off()
}
```

# ATAC-seq Preprocessing

\-**Note**: The initial analysis scripts in [DiffBind](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/DiffBind/inst/doc/DiffBind.pdf) were run non-interactively d/t high resource requirements. Additionally, we noticed differences in calculations for the matrices from this, which we believe is d/t to [differences in floating point calculations between different server architecture on our lab server](https://support.bioconductor.org/p/9162767/).

## Step 1: Create a data matrix for peaks using DiffBind, and then use DESeq2 to perform the pairwise comparisons

-   This is the core analysis step of the ATAC-seq
-   The DiffBind syntax and plotting is clunky, so I use DiffBind to load in my peaks and create a matrix of the peakset before pulling this and continuing analysis in DESeq2

```{r, ATACseq Preprocessing, Step 1, echo = FALSE}
library(DiffBind)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
# Load in DiffBind sample sheet
diffbind_ss <- read_csv("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/analysis/diffBind_ss_idr_rmsk.csv")
diffbind_ko_wt <- function(sample_name){
  # Subset the samples for the given cell lines from the sample sheet
  ss_sub <- diffbind_ss %>% filter(Tissue == sample_name) %>% filter(Condition %in% c("WT", "KO"))
  # Make a DiffBind object and then extract a DESeq2 DataSet object from it
  samples_dba = dba(sampleSheet=ss_sub) %>% dba.count(summits = FALSE)
  dbo <- dba(samples_dba) %>% dba.contrast(minMembers = 2) %>% dba.analyze(method = DBA_DESEQ2, bRetrieveAnalysis=FALSE)
  ds2 <- dba.analyze(dbo, bRetrieveAnalysis = TRUE)
  pn <- dba.peakset(dbo, bRetrieve = T, bRemoveM = T, bRemoveRandom = T) %>% utilsFanc::gr.get.loci()
  ct <- ds2@assays@data$counts
  rownames(ct) <- pn
  # Save the DESeq2 DataSet object with the ATAC-seq data for the given cell line
  saveRDS(ct, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_deseq2_mat.rds", rds_path, sample_name))

  # Run the same DESeq2 analyses as above on the dataset
  # Load in the previously produced counts table
  count_df <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_deseq2_mat.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  # Try filtering based on counts 
  # count_df_filt <- count_df[rowSums(count_df > 20) >= 2, ]
  # count_df <- count_df_filt
  # Create a sample information data frame by separating the column names of the counts data frame
  sample_info <- strsplit(colnames(count_df), split = "_")
  sample_df <- do.call(rbind, sample_info)
  colnames(sample_df) <- c("Cell", "Mut", "Treatment", "Rep")
  sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_df)
  rownames(sample_df) <- paste0(sample_df$Cell, "_", sample_df$Mut, "_", sample_df$Treatment, "_", sample_df$Rep)
  colnames(count_df) <- rownames(sample_df)
  # Create a group variable that is a concatenation of the mutational status and treatment
  sample_df$group <- paste(sample_df$Mut, sample_df$Treatment, sep = "_")

  # Create a dds object to run DESeq2 
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_df,
                                colData = sample_df,
                                design = ~ Rep + group)
  
  # Run DESeq2 and pull results for the same comparisons as RNAseq
  dds1 <- DESeq(dds)
  saveRDS(dds1, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_dds_obj.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  # Comp1: (p53 effect, no treatment) = WT untreated v. KO untreated
  res1 <- results(dds1, name = "group_WT_CTRL_vs_KO_CTRL")
  # orig_dds <- readRDS("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/analysis_v2/data_objects/A549_dds_obj.rds")
  
  saveRDS(res1, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTCTRLvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  ## Comp2 (p53 effect, treatment) = WT treated v. KO treated
  res2 <- results(dds1, contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "KO_DP"))
  saveRDS(res2, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvKODP.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  ## Comp3 (Treatment effect with p53) = WT untreated v. WT treated
  res3 <- results(dds1, contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"))
  saveRDS(res3, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvWTCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  ## Comp4 (Treatment effect with p53 KO) = KO untreated v. KO treated
  res4 <- results(dds1, name = "group_KO_DP_vs_KO_CTRL")
  saveRDS(res4, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_KODPvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  ## Comp5 (Combined effect of p53 and treatment) = KO untreated v. WT treated
  res5 <- results(dds1, name = "group_WT_DP_vs_KO_CTRL")
  saveRDS(res5, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name))

  # Create a composite data frame with all of the ATAC-seq results
  # Comp1: (p53 effect, no treatment) = WT untreated v. KO untreated
  res1 <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTCTRLvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name)) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(res1) <- paste(sample_name, "WTCTRLvKOCTRL", colnames(res1), sep = "_")
  res1 <- res1 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  ## Comp2 (p53 effect, treatment) = WT treated v. KO treated 
  res2 <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvKODP.rds", rds_path, sample_name)) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(res2) <- paste(sample_name, "WTDPvKODP", colnames(res2), sep = "_")
  res2 <- res2 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  ## Comp3 (Treatment effect with p53) = WT untreated v. WT treated
  res3 <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvWTCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name)) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(res3) <- paste(sample_name, "WTDPvWTCTRL", colnames(res3), sep = "_")
  res3 <- res3 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  ## Comp4 (Treatment effect with p53 KO) = KO untreated v. KO treated
  res4 <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_KODPvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name)) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(res4) <- paste(sample_name, "KODPvKOCTRL", colnames(res4), sep = "_")
  res4 <- res4 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  ## Comp5 (Combined effect of p53 and treatment) = KO untreated v. WT treated
  res5 <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_WTDPvKOCTRL.rds", rds_path, sample_name)) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(res5) <- paste(sample_name, "WTDPvKOCTRL", colnames(res5), sep = "_")
  res5 <- res5 %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  # Join all 5 of these data frames
  joint_df <- join_all(list(res1, res2, res3, res4, res5), by = "region_name")
  # Join this data frame with the counts information from the DDS object
  dds <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_dds_obj.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  ct <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame %>% rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")
  # Join the counts with the joint data frame
  joint_ct <- left_join(ct, joint_df, by = "region_name")
  # Write the joint counts file with DE information to a .csv
  write.csv(joint_ct, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_atac_joint_counts_DAR.csv", outputs_path, sample_name))
} 
map(c("A549", "HCT116", "RKO"), diffbind_ko_wt)
```

## Step 2: Identify overlaps in the ATAC-seq data with DP summits, TE overlaps, p53 motifs, and between cell lines

-   This is a complicated step that grew as the analysis continued. It loads in the previously generated DESeq2 outputs for differentially-accessible peaks, and then overlaps them with the TE-overlapping peak output (done in bedtools), p53 motifs, and other samples to define "shared peaks"

```{r, ATACseq Preprocessing, Step 2, echo = FALSE}
####################################################################################### 
# Iterate overlap identification between p53 motifs, DP summits, and between cell lines 
#######################################################################################
# Create vectors to hold the cell line names and p53 status information
sample_name_vec <- c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116")
p53_status_vec <- c("WTCTRLvKOCTRL", "WTDPvKODP", "WTDPvWTCTRL", "KODPvKOCTRL", "WTDPvKOCTRL")
iterate_cell_line_overlaps <- function(p53_status){
  # Initiate an empty data frame to append to later
  output_df <- data.frame(atac_id = character())
  #p53_status <- p53_status_vec[3]
  for (i in seq_along(sample_name_vec)){
    samp_gr <- NULL
    samp_te_p53 <- NULL
    df <- NULL
    samp_output <- NULL
    #i <- 1
    # Select the sample from the sample name vector
    sample_name = sample_name_vec[i]
    # Create a vector of remaining samples to load for overlaps 
    remaining_samples <- sample_name_vec[-i]
    # Load in the target sample-specific .rds file, add a column containing the ATAC region information, and add DAR information
    samp_gr <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, sample_name, p53_status)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    # Create an ID to identify the ATAC-seq region and separate it into start, stop, and end columns for later conversion to GRanges
    rownames_to_column("atac_id") %>% 
    mutate(seqnames = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 1), 
           start = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 2) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 1) %>% as.numeric, 
           end = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 2) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 2) %>% as.numeric) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-atac_id) %>% mutate(atac_id = str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% 
    # Label differentially-accessible regions between Treatment and Ctrl and convert to GRanges format to calculate overlaps 
    mutate(DAR = case_when(log2FoldChange > 1 & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up", log2FoldChange < -1 & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down", TRUE ~ NA)) %>% as_granges()
    # DAR labeling debug: Print the DARs labeled per sample
    print(paste("Sample", sample_name, " ", p53_status, "DAR summary:"))
    print(table(samp_gr$DAR, useNA = "always"))
    # Load in the TEs that overlap summits and have 50% overlap with the ATAC-seq region from the DP file
    # Pull the comparison from the p53 status vec 
    p53_sel <- p53_status %>% str_split_i(., "v", 1) %>% str_sub(., end = 2)
    cond_sel <- p53_status %>% str_split_i(., "v", 1) %>% str_sub(., start = 3)
    te_overlaps <- read_delim(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/bam/idr/TE_overlap/%s_%s_%s-idr_TE_overlap.bed", sample_name, p53_sel, cond_sel), col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "te_subfamily", "te_class", "te_family"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      # Add a TE identifier column containing the TE information, and then subset for unique values of this column (i.e. unique TEs) before converting to GRanges
      mutate(te_str = str_c(seqnames, start, end, te_class, te_family, te_subfamily, sep = ":")) %>% distinct(te_str, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% filter(te_class %in% c("LINE", "SINE", "LTR", "DNA")) %>% select(-te_str) %>% as_granges()
    # Join the GRanges objects by overlaps, add unique combinations of DAR information and TE information, and convert back to a GRanges object
    samp_gr_te <- join_overlap_left(samp_gr, te_overlaps) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
      mutate(tot_str = case_when(!is.na(te_family) ~ str_c(atac_id, te_class, te_family, te_subfamily, sep = ":"), is.na(te_family) ~ atac_id)) %>% as_granges()
    # Load in p53 motif overlap information 
    p53_granges <- read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/p53_dmso_dox/chip/data/p53.homer.KnownMotif.hg38.bed.gz", col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "motif", "score", "strand"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% as_granges()
    # Overlap this p53 GRanges object with the .idr summit file
    p53_sep1 <- str_split_i(p53_status, "v", 1) %>% str_sub(., end = 2)
    p53_sep2 <- str_split_i(p53_status, "v", 1) %>% str_sub(., start = 3)
    idr_file_pre <- str_c(sample_name, p53_sep1, p53_sep2, sep = "_")
    idr_summits <- read_delim(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/bam/idr/summit_overlap/%s_idr_summits.bed", idr_file_pre), col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), show_col_types = FALSE)[1:3] %>% as_granges()
    p53_sum <- join_overlap_inner(p53_granges, idr_summits) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>% mutate(name_str = str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% distinct(name_str, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::select(-name_str) %>% mutate(summit = "p53_summit") %>% as_granges
    # Join the GRanges objects by overlaps
    samp_te_p53 <- join_overlap_left(samp_gr_te, p53_granges) %>% as.data.frame %>% distinct(tot_str, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% as_granges %>% join_overlap_left(., p53_sum) %>% as.data.frame %>% distinct(tot_str, .keep_all = TRUE)
    # Add the sample name to the columns containing the sample/comparison-specific information
    colnames(samp_te_p53)[6:13] <- str_c(sample_name, "_", colnames(samp_te_p53)[6:13])
    samp_te_p53 <- samp_te_p53 %>% mutate(atac_id = samp_te_p53[[12]])
    for (j in seq_along(remaining_samples)){
      #j <- 1
      # Load in the remaining sample data frame and label DARs
      remaining_df <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, remaining_samples[[j]], p53_status)) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("atac_id") %>% 
      mutate(seqnames = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 1), start = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 2) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 1) %>% as.numeric, end = str_split_i(atac_id, ":", 2) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 2) %>% as.numeric) %>% dplyr::select(-atac_id) %>% mutate(atac_id = str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% 
      mutate(DAR = case_when(log2FoldChange > 1 & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up", log2FoldChange < -1 & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down", TRUE ~ NA)) %>% 
      select(seqnames, start, end, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, atac_id, DAR)
      # Add the sample name to the column names of the data frame
      colnames(remaining_df)[4:ncol(remaining_df)] <- str_c(remaining_samples[j], "_", colnames(remaining_df)[4:ncol(remaining_df)])
      # Convert both the sample data frame and the remaining sample dataframe to GRanges
      samp_gr <- samp_te_p53 %>% as_granges()
      remaining_gr <- remaining_df %>% as_granges()
      # Pull out the center 100 bp to check for overlaps 
      samp_gr_cent <- mutate(anchor_center(samp_gr), width = 100)
      rem_gr_cent <- mutate(anchor_center(remaining_gr), width = 100)
      # Join the sample data and remaining sample by the center, then format the output to label the combined data frame 
      cent_ov <- join_overlap_inner(samp_gr_cent, rem_gr_cent) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, atac_id) %>% 
        # Add the overlap information
        mutate(!!str_c(remaining_samples[j], "_center_overlap") := "TRUE") %>% mutate(!!str_c(remaining_samples[j], "_center_overlap_id") := str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% dplyr::select(-c(seqnames, start, end))
      # Join the sample and remaining sample GRanges objects and add the center overlap information
      df <- join_overlap_left(samp_gr, remaining_gr) %>% as.data.frame %>% left_join(., cent_ov) %>% distinct(tot_str, .keep_all = TRUE)
      # Convert to data frame and append to the combined data frame
      output_df <- left_join(df, output_df, by = "atac_id")
    }
    # Fix the columns/column names of the output data frame 
    samp_output <- output_df[, c(1:31, 52:61)]
    colnames(samp_output)[1:21] <- colnames(samp_te_p53)[1:21]
    samp_output <- samp_output %>% distinct(tot_str, .keep_all = TRUE)
    print(table(samp_output[[13]]))
    # Write the overlapped data frame to a .csv file
    # write_csv(samp_output, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_deseq2_norm_%s_sample_te_p53_overlap.csv", outputs_path, sample_name, p53_status))
    write_csv(samp_output, file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_deseq2_norm_%s_sample_te_p53_overlap_20260212.csv", outputs_path, sample_name, p53_status))
  }
  # Reset the output data frame for the next iteration
  rm(samp_output)
  rm(output_df)
  output_df <- data.frame(atac_id = character())
}
map(p53_status_vec, iterate_cell_line_overlaps)
```

# WGBS Preprocessing

## Step 1: Load in the file lists and use the `run_dss` function to identify differentially-methylated regions

-   Most of the work for the WGBS analysis is done upstream of this, the main utility here is to get the average methylation over individual CpG sites for plotting later
-   This was also run non-interactively d/t required resources

```{r, WGBS Preprocessing, echo = FALSE}
library(DSS)
library(stringr)
library(magrittr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)

# Load in the files to analyze, grepping the KO and WT files
rds_dir <- "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/wgbs/data/DSS/rds"
file_list <- list.files("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/wgbs/data/6_DSS", full.names = TRUE) %>% grep("_KO_|_WT_", ., value = TRUE)

# Write two functions, one to pull out individual file names and separate into WT and KO groups, and the other to run DSS
split_file_list <- function(file_list){
  #file_list <- file_list
  # Split the sample names into a vector to iterate the DSS function over
  sample_list <- str_split_i(basename(file_list), "_", 1) %>% unique()
  for(i in seq_along(sample_list)){
    #i <- 1
    # Split the KO and WT samples
    KO_samples <- grep(sample_list[i], file_list, value = TRUE) %>% grep("_KO_", ., value = TRUE)
    WT_samples <- grep(sample_list[i], file_list, value = TRUE) %>% grep("_WT_", ., value = TRUE)
    # Run the DSS function over the samples
    run_dss(KO_samples)
    run_dss(WT_samples)
  }
}

run_dss <- function(sample_input){
  #sample_input <- KO_samples
  # Make a name vector from the file list for the BSeq object
  name_vec <- sample_input %>% basename %>% str_split_i(., "_R1", 1)
  # Load in the sample data frames containing the CpG methylation informations
  sample_df <- map(sample_input, read_delim)
  # Make a BSseq obj from the data frames
  BSobj <- makeBSseqData(sample_df, name_vec)
  # Save the BSseq object to a .rds file for when the dmlTest inevitably crashes
  file_name <- paste0(str_split_i(name_vec[1], "_", 1), "_", str_split_i(name_vec[1], "_", 2))
  saveRDS(BSobj, file = sprintf("%s/%s_BSseq_obj.rds", rds_dir, file_name))
  # Separate the two treatments into two groups for the DML test
  gr1 <- name_vec %>% grep("_DP_", ., value = TRUE)
  gr2 <- name_vec %>% grep("_CTRL_", ., value = TRUE)
  # Run the test for differentially-methylated loci on the samples and save to a .rds
  dmlTest <- DMLtest(BSobj, group1=c(gr1), group2=c(gr2), smoothing=TRUE, smoothing.span=500, ncores=8)
  saveRDS(dmlTest, file = sprintf("%s/%s_dmlTest_obj_20260406.rds", rds_dir, file_name))
}

split_file_list(file_list)

# Load in the resultant .rds files
list.files(rds_dir)
```

-   Below is the code used to produce the differential analyses of the RNA-seq data. It includes data not included in the paper (the KO175 and KO273 cell lines). Descriptions of the steps are listed below

## Step 1: Basic filtering

-   This step filters for likely false positive transcripts in the data identified through TEProf3, as well as transcripts that were only quantified in one biological replicate. A cartoon depiction and brief description of the individual steps can be found in Figure 3B.
-   The input to this step is the TEProf3 annotation and quantification. The output is a list of transcripts (selTx) that fulfill the criteria set out below
-   Criteria: TE-Transcript is observed in at least one sample in both biological replicates of that sample. For monoexonic TE-transcripts, the TPM has to be \>5 in one of the samples. For polyexonic TE-transcripts, at least 1 biological rep has to have a TPM \> 5, at least 2 uniquely mapped SJ capturing reads, and a ratio of upstream:downstream SJ captures \< 0.5

```{r RNAseq Preprocessing, Step 1, echo=FALSE}
########################################################################################
# 1. Filter the TEProf3 outputs to remove likely false-positives prior to running DESeq2
########################################################################################
# Load in the TE quantification file and annotation file from TEProf3
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_quant <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz", assembly_dir), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Basic filtering: Filtering for samples of interest and agreement between biol. reps
basic_filtering <- function(sample_name, p53_str){
  # For testing, silence when running
  # sample_name <- "HCT116"
  # p53_str <- "_KO_|_WT_"
  # Filter for the samples of interest (sample and p53 status)
  te_quant_basic_filt <- te_quant %>% 
    filter(grepl(sample_name, stringtie_sample)) %>% 
    filter(grepl(p53_str, stringtie_sample)) %>%
  # Filter out transcripts with unmatched 0 values between sampleasss of the same treatment/condition
    mutate(treatment_cond = str_c(str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 3), str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 4), sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(transcript_id, treatment_cond) %>%
    mutate(to_keep = all(stringtie_tpm == 0) | all(stringtie_tpm > 0)) %>%
    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(all(to_keep)) %>% dplyr::select(-to_keep) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  # Filter out transcripts where all values are 0
    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(!all(stringtie_tpm == 0))
  # Use different filtering parameters for monoexonic and polyexonic transcripts 
  mono_filt <- te_quant_basic_filt %>% 
  # Higher TPM cutoff than polyexonic transcripts 
    filter(any(stringtie_tpm > 5)) %>% 
    pull(transcript_id)
  poly_filt <- te_quant_basic_filt %>% 
  # Suggested cutoffs for TPM, SJ coverage, and SJ ratio 
    filter(any(stringtie_tpm > 2)) %>% 
    filter(any(perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream > 2)) %>% 
    filter(any(SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream/perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream < 0.5)) %>% 
    pull(transcript_id)
  te_quant_sel <- c(mono_filt, poly_filt)
return(te_quant_sel)
}
# Map the function over the cell lines with different p53 status inputs and save the output files to .rds files
cell_lines <- c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116")
# KO/WT
p53_ko_wt <- map(cell_lines, basic_filtering, p53_str = "_KO_|_WT_")
names(p53_ko_wt) <- cell_lines
saveRDS(p53_ko_wt, file = sprintf("%s/rna/p53_ko_wt_selTx_%s.rds", rds_path, date))

saveRDS(p53_koev_kowt, file = sprintf("%s/rna/p53_koev_kowt_selTx_%s.rds", rds_path, date))
# KOWT/KO175

names(p53_kowt_ko175) <- cell_lines
saveRDS(p53_kowt_ko175, file = sprintf("%s/rna/p53_kowt_ko175_selTx_%s.rds", rds_path, date))
```

## Step 2: Checking for ATAC-seq summit overlaps

-   This step checks the first exon of all of the TE-transcripts, and checks to see if they overlap any ATAC-seq peak summits for the same sample by iterateing a function, `check_atac_overlaps`, over all 3 cell lines. This function pulls the first exon (all of a monoexonic TE-transcript, and a strand-specific first exon for polyexonic TE-transcripts) and checks to see if this region overlaps the summit of an ATAC-seq peak in the corresponding cell line + condition.
-   The input is a comparison that will be put into DESeq2, and the output is a list object containing the IDs of monoexonic TE-transcripts, polyexonic TE-transcripts, and canonical transcripts that have summit overlaps

```{r RNAseq Preprocessing, Step 2, echo=FALSE}
###################################################
# 2. Label all samples for ATAC-seq summit overlaps 
###################################################
cell_lines <- c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116")
check_atac_overlaps <- function(comparison_name){
  # List the files in the .rds directory that contain the comparison name of interest and load them in
  # comparison_name <- comparisons[1]
  # i <- 1
  # comp_of_int <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = paste0("p53_", comparison_name), full.names = TRUE) %>% readRDS()
  comp_of_int <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = paste0("p53_", comparison_name, "_selTx_", date), full.names = TRUE) %>% readRDS()
  for(i in seq_along(cell_lines)){
    #i <- 2
    sel_cell_line <- comp_of_int[[i]]
    cell_line_name <- names(comp_of_int[i])
    # Filter the annotation file for transcripts that remain after the filtering above
    te_anno_filt <- te_anno %>% filter(transcript_id %in% sel_cell_line)
    # Make a table that has frequencies of the exons for the TE-transcripts to print below
    te_exon_no <- te_anno_filt$transcript_total_num_of_exon %>% table %>% as.data.frame %>% rename_with(~ c("Exon_count", "Freq"))
    te_exon_no <- te_exon_no %>% mutate(Exon_number = case_when(Exon_count == 1 ~ "Monoexonic", TRUE ~ "Polyexonic"))
    # Make data frames that hold the monoexonic transcripts and polyexonic transcripts and convert to GenomicRanges objects
    te_anno_mono <- te_anno_filt %>% filter(annotation_gene_intron_chain == "mono_exonic")
    te_anno_mono_gr <- te_anno_mono %>% dplyr::select(1:4) %>% rename_with(~ c("seqnames", "start", "end", "transcript_id")) %>% as_granges
    te_anno_poly <- te_anno_filt %>% filter(transcript_id %!in% te_anno_mono$transcript_id)
    # Properly extract the first exon of polyexonic transcripts in a strand-specific manner
    te_anno_poly_gr <- te_anno_poly %>% dplyr::select(transcript_chr, transcript_strand, transcript_coordinates, transcript_id) %>% mutate(tss_extract = case_when(transcript_strand == "+" ~ str_extract(transcript_coordinates, "^.*?(?=\\)\\,\\s)") %>% str_remove(., "^\\[?\\("), transcript_strand == "-" ~ sub(".*\\),\\s", "", transcript_coordinates) %>% str_replace_all(., "[\\[\\]()]", ""))) %>% mutate(start = as.numeric(str_split_i(tss_extract, ",", 1)), end = as.numeric(str_split_i(tss_extract, ",", 2))) %>% dplyr::select(transcript_chr, start, end, transcript_strand, transcript_id) %>% rename_with(~ c("seqnames", "start", "end", "strand", "transcript_id")) %>% as_granges
    # Load in the ATAC-seq summit files and check for overlaps in the first exon (TSS) of the TE-transcripts and ATAC-summits
    comps <- str_split(comparison_name, pattern = "_") %>% lapply(., str_to_upper) %>% unlist %>% paste(., collapse = "|")
    atac_summit_files <- list.files("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/bam/idr/summit_overlap", pattern = cell_lines[[i]], full.names = TRUE) %>% grep("summits", ., value = TRUE) %>% grep("CTRL|DP", ., value = TRUE) %>% grep(comps, ., value = TRUE)
    atac_summits <- map(atac_summit_files,  ~ read_delim(.x, col_select = c(1:3, 8:9), show_col_types = FALSE) |> rename_with(~ c("seqnames", "start", "end", "peak_name", "score")) |> as_granges())
    atac_grl <- GRangesList(atac_summits) %>% unlist() %>% GenomicRanges::reduce()
    # Overlap the monoexonic and polyexonic transcripts with the ATAC-seq summits
    te_anno_mono_ov <- join_overlap_inner(te_anno_mono_gr, atac_grl) %>% as.data.frame() %>% pull(transcript_id) %>% unique()
    te_anno_poly_ov <- join_overlap_inner(te_anno_poly_gr, atac_grl) %>% as.data.frame() %>% pull(transcript_id) %>% unique()
    # Before dividing, repeat this process with canonical transcripts 
    p53_to_grep <- comparison_name %>% str_replace(., "_", "_|_") %>% paste0("_", ., "_") %>% toupper()
    canonical_anno <- read_gff(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/rna/data/bam/all_samp/assembled/TE_transcript_consensus.filtered.with_gene_annotation.gtf") %>%
                    as.data.frame() %>% 
                    filter(source %in% c("HAVANA","ENSEMBL")) %>% 
                    filter(exon_number == 1) %>% dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, width, strand, transcript_id)
    orig_quant <- read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/rna/data/bam/all_samp/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
                    filter(grepl(cell_line_name, stringtie_sample)) %>% 
                    filter(grepl(p53_to_grep, stringtie_sample)) %>%
                    mutate(treatment_cond = str_c(str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 2), str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 3), sep = "_")) %>%
                    group_by(transcript_id, treatment_cond) %>%
                    mutate(to_keep = all(stringtie_tpm == 0) | all(stringtie_tpm > 0)) %>%
                    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(all(to_keep)) %>% dplyr::select(-to_keep) %>% ungroup() %>%
                    #> 14689 transcripts
                    # Filter out transcripts not found in any of the samples
                    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(!all(stringtie_tpm == 0))
    canonical_anno_filt <- canonical_anno %>% filter(transcript_id %in% orig_quant$transcript_id) %>% as_granges
    canonical_anno_ov <- join_overlap_inner(canonical_anno_filt, atac_grl) %>% as.data.frame() %>% pull(transcript_id) %>% unique()
    # Make a list object for the outputs of interest - the monoexonic, polyexonic, and canonical transcripts with ATAC-summit overlaps in their first exon
    list_of_int <- list(te_anno_mono_ov, te_anno_poly_ov, canonical_anno_ov)
    names(list_of_int) <- c("monoexonic_overlap", "polyexonic_overlap", "canonical_tx_overlap")
    # Write the output to an .rds object with the cell line and comparison information
    # saveRDS(list_of_int, file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_%s_summit_overlapping_tx.rds", rds_path, cell_line_name, comparison_name))
    saveRDS(list_of_int, file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_%s_summit_overlapping_tx_%s.rds", rds_path, cell_line_name, comparison_name, date))
  }
}
comparisons <- c("ko_wt", "koev_kowt", "kowt_ko175", "kowt_ko273")
map(comparisons, check_atac_overlaps)
```

## Step 2.5: Check the TE usage of the consensus reference

-   One of the issues with TEProf3 is that it can pick up the 3' end of TEs adjacent to a canonical promoter and call this as a unique transcript, barely overlapping with the TE. Whether or not to include these events is a decision to perform prior to analysis and depends on the goal of sensitivity versus specificity. Since for this study we lack long-read data or CAGE-seq to determine the TSS through secondary means, I choose to filter these transcripts to try and improve specificity of my annotation.
-   This step takes the unfiltered transcripts (from the 20251217 DESeq2 output) and shows the difference in the TE overlap when transcripts with low overlaps with the TEs are removed, split by TE class

```{r RNAseq Preprocessing, Step 2.5, echo=FALSE}
#######################################################
# Step 2.5 Plot the TE usage of the consensus reference 
#######################################################
repeatmasker <- read.table(file="/scratch/cmccornack/DNA_LINE_SINE_LTR_UCSC_rmsk.bed")[,c(4,7,8)] %>% unique()
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sel <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(TE_chr, TE_start, TE_stop, TE_subfamily, TE_family, TE_class, teprof3_gene_name)
gene_anno <- read_gff(file = sprintf("%s/TE_transcript_consensus.filtered.with_gene_annotation.gtf", assembly_dir)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
              dplyr::select(c(transcript_id, gene_name)) %>% distinct(transcript_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
te_quant <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_quantification.tsv.gz", assembly_dir), show_col_types = FALSE)
# Load in the TE-transcripts used for the analysis 
# Note: The DESeq2 object version used for subsequent plotting and analysis below (20260105) only has the filtered transcripts, whereas this previous version does not. To show the difference, this (older) version is used for plotting 
rds_files <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern ="KO_WT_deseq2_20251217", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
uniq_tx_names <- c(rds_files[[1]][[1]] %>% rownames, rds_files[[2]][[1]] %>% rownames, rds_files[[3]][[1]] %>% rownames) %>% unique
sel_tx <- uniq_tx_names[uniq_tx_names %in% te_anno_sel$teprof3_gene_name]

sel_tx <- sel_tx
te_anno <- te_anno
sel_tx_name <- "consensus reference TEs"
TE_TSS_intersection <- te_anno %>% filter(teprof3_gene_name %in% sel_tx) %>%
              dplyr::select(c(TE_chr, TE_start, TE_stop, transcript_strand, TE_subfamily, transcript_id, gene_name, transcript_coordinates, transcript_total_num_of_exon, transcript_start, transcript_stop)) %>%
              tidyr::unite("ID", c("TE_subfamily","gene_name","TE_chr", "TE_start", "TE_stop","transcript_strand"), sep=":", remove=F) %>% unique() %>%
              mutate(TE_downstream_intersect = case_when(
                transcript_strand == "+" ~ TE_stop - transcript_start,
                transcript_strand == "-" ~  transcript_stop- TE_start)) %>%
              mutate(TE_upstream_intersect = case_when(
                transcript_strand == "+" ~ (transcript_start - TE_start),
                transcript_strand == "-" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_stop)
              )) %>%
              mutate(TE_down_perc = case_when(
                transcript_strand == "+" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start),
                transcript_strand == "-" ~ (transcript_stop- TE_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start)
              )) %>%
              mutate(TE_up_perc = case_when(
                transcript_strand == "+" ~ (transcript_start - TE_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start),
                transcript_strand == "-" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_stop)/(TE_stop - TE_start)
              )) %>% dplyr::select(ID, transcript_id, TE_upstream_intersect,TE_downstream_intersect, TE_down_perc, TE_up_perc) %>%
              tidyr::separate(ID, sep=":", into=c("V4", "gene", "chr", "start", "stop", "strand"), remove=F)

TE_TSS_intersection <- left_join(TE_TSS_intersection, repeatmasker) %>% dplyr::filter(! V7 == "NA")

# Make a common plot theme and define the TE colors 
common_theme <- function() {theme_pubr() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10), legend.position = "right", legend.justification = "center")}
te_colors <- c("LINE" = "#FF8E56", "SINE" = "#DB544D", "LTR" = "#528C4C", "DNA" = "#7896EE")

# Helper function for plotting 
create_density_plot <- function(data, title, color_var = NULL) {
  if (is.null(color_var)) {
    # Plot without color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc)) +
      geom_density(fill = "white", alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
  } else {
    # Plot with color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
      geom_density(fill = NA)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.1, 0.9), linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, x = "TE Percent", y = "Density") +
    common_theme() +
    xlim(0, 1)
  
  if (!is.null(color_var)) {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = te_colors, name = "TE Type")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Make a new object to hold the filtered dataset 
filtered_10_90 <- TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter((TE_down_perc < 0.9 & TE_down_perc > 0.1) | (TE_upstream_intersect > 10 & TE_downstream_intersect > 10))

# Create all plots
plots <- list(
  # All transcripts
  create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection, 
                      sprintf("All\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = NULL),
  
  # Filtered transcripts
  create_density_plot(filtered_10_90, 
                      sprintf("Filtered (10-90%% overlap or >10bp)\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = NULL),
  
  # By TE type (unfiltered)
  create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "LTR"), 
                      sprintf("LTR\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "LTR"), 
                      sprintf("LTR Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "DNA"), 
                      sprintf("DNA\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "DNA"), 
                      sprintf("DNA Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "LINE"), 
                      sprintf("LINE\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "LINE"), 
                      sprintf("LINE Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "SINE"), 
                      sprintf("SINE\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"),
  
  create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "SINE"), 
                      sprintf("SINE Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                      color_var = "V7"), 
  
  TE_TSS_intersection, 
  filtered_10_90
)

pl <- wrap_plots(plots[[1]], plots[[3]], plots[[5]], plots[[7]], plots[[9]], plots[[2]], plots[[4]], plots[[6]], plots[[8]], plots[[10]], ncol = 5)
plot(pl)

# png(filename = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/misc_plots/TE_TSS_filtering.png"), width = 15, height = 8, units = "in", bg = "white", res = 600)
```

## Step 3: Final filtering and differential expression analysis in DESeq2

-   This step filters the transcripts in each comparison for those that overlap ATAC-summits and have the desired percent coverage of TEs.
-   Additionally, it sums individual transcripts to the gene level. This creates a confound, because essentially the analysis of TE-transcripts becomes a selective form of alternative isoform analysis. However, this is an important part of the analysis, because it increases the power of the analysis by improving the dispersion estimate of all transcripts, since many of the individual TE-transcripts have low expression levels and would be removed through independent filtering in addition to adding noise to the overall model estimate. It also increases the significance of the TE-transcripts identified for similar reasons.

```{r RNAseq Preprocessing, Step 3, echo=FALSE}
###################################################
# 3. DE Analysis of different sample groupings
###################################################
# Load in the complete TE annotation and pull out the TE-derived mono- and polyexonic transcripts 
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sel <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(TE_chr, TE_start, TE_stop, TE_subfamily, TE_family, TE_class, teprof3_gene_name)
gene_anno <- read_gff(file = sprintf("%s/TE_transcript_consensus.filtered.with_gene_annotation.gtf", assembly_dir)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
              dplyr::select(c(transcript_id, gene_name)) %>% distinct(transcript_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
te_quant <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_quantification.tsv.gz", assembly_dir), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Load in the transcript annotations generated in the previous step, and run differential expression analysis within individual cell lines
# summit_ov_files <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = "summit_overlapping_tx", full.names = TRUE)
summit_ov_files <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = "summit_overlapping_tx_20251217", full.names = TRUE)

for (i in seq_along(summit_ov_files)){
  #i <- 9
  # Pull sample name and comparison from the .rds file name
  samp_name <- summit_ov_files[[i]] %>% basename %>% str_split_i(., "_", 1)
  comp1 <- summit_ov_files[[i]] %>% basename %>% str_split_i(., "_", 2) %>% toupper()
  comp2 <- summit_ov_files[[i]] %>% basename %>% str_split_i(., "_", 3) %>% toupper()
  comparison <- paste(comp1, comp2, sep = "_")
  # Load in the transcripts present within the comparison of interest and filter the TE anno table for these 
  # comp_of_int <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = "p53_", full.names = TRUE) %>% grep(comparison, ., ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE) %>% readRDS()
  comp_of_int <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/rna/",rds_path), pattern = sprintf("p53_%s_%s_selTx_20251217", tolower(comp1), tolower(comp2)), full.names = TRUE) %>% grep(comparison, ., ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE) %>% readRDS()
  sel_comp_tx <- comp_of_int[[samp_name]]
  te_anno_filt <- te_anno %>% filter(transcript_id %in% sel_comp_tx) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% filtered_10_90$transcript_id)
  # Read in the .rds file containing the ATAC-overlap information and pull the monoexonic summit-overlapping transcripts and all polyexonic transcripts
  sel_summit_file <- summit_ov_files[[i]] %>% readRDS()
  mono_ov <- sel_summit_file$monoexonic_overlap
  poly_ov <- sel_summit_file$polyexonic_overlap
  mono_tx <- te_anno_filt %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon < 2) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% mono_ov) %>% pull(transcript_id)
  poly_tx <- te_anno_filt %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon > 1) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% poly_ov) %>% pull(transcript_id)
  # poly_tx <- te_anno_filt %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon > 1) %>% pull(transcript_id)
  sel_tx <- c(mono_tx, poly_tx)
  # Load in the quantification file and select for the samples and transcripts of interest
  quant_sel_canonical <- te_quant %>% filter(!str_detect(transcript_id, "TU\\d+")) %>% 
    mutate(treatment_cond = str_c(str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 3), str_split_i(stringtie_sample, "_", 4), sep = "_")) %>%
    group_by(transcript_id, treatment_cond) %>%
    mutate(to_keep = all(stringtie_tpm == 0) | all(stringtie_tpm > 0)) %>%
    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(all(to_keep)) %>% dplyr::select(-to_keep) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  # Filter out transcripts where all values are 0
    group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(!all(stringtie_tpm == 0)) %>% 
    pull(transcript_id) %>% unique
  # Do the same checks (removing null rows and mismatched rows) for the ENSEMBL transcripts 
  te_quant_sel <- te_quant %>% filter(str_detect(transcript_id, "TU\\d+")) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% sel_tx)
  samp_sel <- paste0("_", samp_name, "_", comp1, "_|_", samp_name, "_", comp2, "_")
  # Filter the quantification table for transcripts meeting the cutoffs and sum individual transcripts with the same gene name
  quant_sel <- te_quant %>% filter(transcript_id %in% quant_sel_canonical) %>% 
                bind_rows(., te_quant_sel) %>% 
                filter(grepl(samp_sel, stringtie_sample)) %>% 
                as.data.table %>% 
                dcast(., transcript_id~sample, value.var = "raw_count") %>% 
                left_join(., gene_anno) %>% 
                group_by(gene_name) %>%
                summarise(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  # Make a sample metadata table
  # Create a sample metadata frame from the column information of quantification table
  sample_info <- strsplit(colnames(quant_sel), split = "_")
  sample_df <- do.call(rbind, sample_info)[2:9,]
  colnames(sample_df) <- c("Cell", "Mut", "Treatment", "Rep")
  sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_df)
  rownames(sample_df) <- paste0(sample_df$Cell, "_", sample_df$Mut, "_", sample_df$Treatment, "_", sample_df$Rep)
  # Create a combined column to the data frame corresponding to the combination of mutational status and treatment status
  sample_df$group <- paste(sample_df$Mut, sample_df$Treatment, sep = "_")
  colnames(quant_sel)[2:9] <- rownames(sample_df)
  # Convert the gene names to rownames 
  quant_sel <- quant_sel %>% column_to_rownames(., var = "gene_name")
  # Run DESeq2
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = quant_sel,
                              colData = sample_df,
                              design = ~ Rep + group)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  # Pull the results from the individual groups
  # Groups 3-5 correspond to KO DP v KO CTRL, WT CTRL v KO CTRL, and WT DP v KO CTRL
  resnames <- resultsNames(dds)[3:5]
  groupnames <- sample_df$group %>% unique %>% as.character()
  res1 <- results(dds, name = resnames[1])
  res2 <- results(dds, name = resnames[2])
  res3 <- results(dds, name = resnames[3])
  res4 <- results(dds, contrast = c("group", groupnames[4], groupnames[2]))
  res5 <- results(dds, contrast = c("group", groupnames[4], groupnames[3]))
  comp_obj <- list(dds, res1, res2, res3, res4, res5)
  # saveRDS(comp_obj, file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_%s_deseq2.rds", rds_path, samp_name, comparison))
  saveRDS(comp_obj, file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_%s_deseq2_%s.rds", rds_path, samp_name, comparison, date))
}
```

# scRNA-seq Preprocessing

## Step 0: Look at TE overlaps of the pseudobulk and bulk libraries

-   Originally, I had planned to compare the quantifications from pseudobulk- and bulk-generated .gtfs, but due to the specificity of the splice junctions I was unable to use the pseudobulk version. Moreover, quantification was done using TEProf3 instead of purpose-built tools, due to the lack of UMIs, and previously observed issues with correct transcript quantification for TE-derived transcripts - in short, tools like STARsolo require an exact TSS, and I observed multiple instances where transcripts that should have been quantified as TE-derived were not quantified.
-   This plotting is the same plotting as above for the pseudobulk- and bulk-generated TE-transcript annotations

```{r}
#############################################################################################################################
# Filtering the pseudobulk and bulk generated TE annotations for the TEProf3 requantification and scCUT&Tag genome generation
#############################################################################################################################
library(plyranges)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
repeatmasker <- read.table(file="/scratch/cmccornack/DNA_LINE_SINE_LTR_UCSC_rmsk.bed")[,c(4,7,8)] %>% unique()
pseudo <- read_tsv(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/pseudobulk_assembly/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
pseudo_filt <- pseudo %>% group_by(transcript_id) %>% 
                   # TEProf3 suggested TPM cutoff 
                   filter(any(stringtie_tpm > 2)) %>% 
                   # Higher cutoff for SJ mapping d/t noise in the scRNA data 
                   filter(any(perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream > 5)) %>% 
                   # TEProf3 suggested SJ ratio cutoff 
                   filter(all(SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream/perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream < 0.5))
pseudo_filt$transcript_id %>% unique %>% length
pseudo_sel_tx <- pseudo_filt$transcript_id %>% unique
# Plot TE usage metrics and distributions of these selected transcripts 

plot_te_usage <- function(sel_tx, te_anno, sel_tx_name){
  # sel_tx <- pseudo_sel_tx
  # te_anno <- pseudo_te_anno
  # sel_tx_name <- "Pseudobulk assembly filtered TEs"
  TE_TSS_intersection <- te_anno %>% filter(transcript_id %in% sel_tx) %>%
                dplyr::select(c(TE_chr, TE_start, TE_stop, transcript_strand, TE_subfamily, transcript_id, gene_name, transcript_coordinates, transcript_total_num_of_exon, transcript_start, transcript_stop)) %>%
                tidyr::unite("ID", c("TE_subfamily","gene_name","TE_chr", "TE_start", "TE_stop","transcript_strand"), sep=":", remove=F) %>% unique() %>%
                mutate(TE_downstream_intersect = case_when(
                  transcript_strand == "+" ~ TE_stop - transcript_start,
                  transcript_strand == "-" ~  transcript_stop- TE_start)) %>%
                mutate(TE_upstream_intersect = case_when(
                  transcript_strand == "+" ~ (transcript_start - TE_start),
                  transcript_strand == "-" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_stop)
                )) %>%
                mutate(TE_down_perc = case_when(
                  transcript_strand == "+" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start),
                  transcript_strand == "-" ~ (transcript_stop- TE_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start)
                )) %>%
                mutate(TE_up_perc = case_when(
                  transcript_strand == "+" ~ (transcript_start - TE_start)/(TE_stop - TE_start),
                  transcript_strand == "-" ~ (TE_stop - transcript_stop)/(TE_stop - TE_start)
                )) %>% dplyr::select(ID, transcript_id, TE_upstream_intersect,TE_downstream_intersect, TE_down_perc, TE_up_perc) %>%
                tidyr::separate(ID, sep=":", into=c("V4", "gene", "chr", "start", "stop", "strand"), remove=F)
  
  TE_TSS_intersection <- left_join(TE_TSS_intersection, repeatmasker) %>% dplyr::filter(! V7 == "NA")
  
  # Make a common plot theme and define the TE colors 
  common_theme <- function() {theme_pubr() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10), legend.position = "right", legend.justification = "center")}
  te_colors <- c("LINE" = "#FF8E56", "SINE" = "#DB544D", "LTR" = "#528C4C", "DNA" = "#7896EE")
  
  # Helper function for plotting 
  create_density_plot <- function(data, title, color_var = NULL) {
    if (is.null(color_var)) {
      # Plot without color aesthetic
      p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc)) +
        geom_density(fill = "white", alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
    } else {
      # Plot with color aesthetic
      p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
        geom_density(fill = NA)
    }
    
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.1, 0.9), linetype = "dashed", 
                 color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
      labs(title = title, x = "TE Percent", y = "Density") +
      common_theme() +
      xlim(0, 1)
    
    if (!is.null(color_var)) {
      p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = te_colors, name = "TE Type")
    }
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Make a new object to hold the filtered dataset 
  filtered_10_90 <- TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter((TE_down_perc < 0.9 & TE_down_perc > 0.1) | (TE_upstream_intersect > 10 & TE_downstream_intersect > 10))
  
  # Create all plots
  plots <- list(
    # All transcripts
    create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection, 
                        sprintf("All\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = NULL),
    
    # Filtered transcripts
    create_density_plot(filtered_10_90, 
                        sprintf("Filtered (10-90%% overlap or >10bp)\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = NULL),
    
    # By TE type (unfiltered)
    create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "LTR"), 
                        sprintf("LTR\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "LTR"), 
                        sprintf("LTR Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "DNA"), 
                        sprintf("DNA\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "DNA"), 
                        sprintf("DNA Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "LINE"), 
                        sprintf("LINE\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "LINE"), 
                        sprintf("LINE Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(TE_TSS_intersection %>% filter(V7 == "SINE"), 
                        sprintf("SINE\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7"),
    
    create_density_plot(filtered_10_90 %>% filter(V7 == "SINE"), 
                        sprintf("SINE Filtered\n%s", sel_tx_name), 
                        color_var = "V7")
  )
return(plots)
}
pseudo_plots <- plot_te_usage(pseudo_sel_tx, pseudo_te_anno, "Pseudobulk assembly filtered TEs") %>% wrap_plots(ncol = 2)
pseudo_plots

# Repeat with the bulk annotation 
bulk <- read_tsv(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz", show_col_types = FALSE)
bulk_filt <- bulk %>% group_by(transcript_id) %>% 
                   # TEProf3 suggested threshold values

                   filter(any(perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream > 2)) %>%

bulk_filt$transcript_id %>% unique %>% length
bulk_sel_tx <- bulk_filt$transcript_id %>% unique
bulk_te_anno <- read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/assembled/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

write_gff(pseudo_filt_anno, file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/pseudobulk_assembly/pseudobulk_filtered_assembly_%s.gtf", date))
bulk_filt_anno <- read_gff("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/assembled/teprof3_output_TE_transcript_consensus.gtf") %>% filter(transcript_id %in% bulk_sel_tx)
write_gff(bulk_filt_anno, file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/bulk_filtered_assembly_%s.gtf", date))
```

## Step 1: Format the TEProf3 individual outs into a format usable by Seurat

-   All of the TEProf3 quantification is done for individual cells, so the quantification files need to be imported and concatenated to form a matrix that I can use as a counts matrix for Seurat
-   This could be improved by using `data.tables` instead of `data.frames` but I'm more familiar with the latter.

```{r, scRNA Preprocessing Step 1, echo = FALSE}
library(RSpectra)
library(scCustomize)
library(UCell)
library(cluster)
# Set up directory structure for scRNA analysis 
date = Sys.Date() %>% gsub("-", "", .)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4000 * 1024^2)

#################################################################################################################################################################
# Load in the individual quantification files from TEProf3, filter according to suggested parameters, and reformat into a format that can be imported into Seurat
#################################################################################################################################################################
teprof3_output_dirs <- list.dirs("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/", recursive = FALSE)
# Create lists to hold the filtering metrics from the output files (TPM, SJ downstream mapping, ratio between upstream and downstream SJs captured)
# Load an example data frame to pull the transcript IDs from TEProf3 for future appending
t_ids <- quant_file <- read_tsv(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/group_1/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz") %>% pull(transcript_id) %>% unique
tpm_df <- data.frame(transcript_id = t_ids)
downstreamSJ_df <- data.frame(transcript_id =  t_ids)
sjRatio_df <- data.frame(transcript_id =  t_ids)
for (i in seq_along(teprof3_output_dirs)){
  # Load the quantification file output
  quant_file <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/STAR_rev/20250921_TEProf3_scrna_guided_array_small/group_%s/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz", i))
  # Because of the length of the dataframe, pull the individual characteristics used for filtering (TPM, SJ downstream mapping, ratio between upstream and downstream SJs captured) into two separate data frames 
  tpm_samp_df <- quant_file %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, stringtie_tpm, stringtie_sample) %>% mutate(sample = str_replace(stringtie_sample, "_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.stats", "")) %>% dplyr::select(-(stringtie_sample)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = stringtie_tpm)
  downstreamSJ_samp_df <- quant_file %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream, stringtie_sample) %>% mutate(sample = str_replace(stringtie_sample, "_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.stats", "")) %>% dplyr::select(-(stringtie_sample)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream)
  sj_ratio_samp_df <- quant_file %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream, SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream, stringtie_sample) %>% mutate(sample = str_replace(stringtie_sample, "_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.stats", "")) %>% mutate(SJ_ratio = case_when(SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream == 0 & perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream == 0 ~ NA_character_,                                                                                                                                            SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream <= (0.5 * perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream) ~ "keep", 
                                     TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% dplyr::select(-c(stringtie_sample, perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream, SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = SJ_ratio)
  # colbind the sample data frame to the complete data frame 
  tpm_df <- left_join(tpm_df, tpm_samp_df)
  downstreamSJ_df <- left_join(downstreamSJ_df, downstreamSJ_samp_df)
  sjRatio_df <- left_join(sjRatio_df, sj_ratio_samp_df)
}
# Filter the complete data frames for transcripts passing the suggested thresholds from TEProf3
tpm_filt <- tpm_df[rowSums(tpm_df[2:ncol(tpm_df)] > 1) > 0, ] %>% pull(transcript_id)
sjuniq_filt <- sjRatio_df %>% filter(if_any(contains("text"), ~ str_detect(., "keep"))) %>% pull(transcript_id)
ds_filt <- downstreamSJ_df[rowSums(downstreamSJ_df[2:ncol(downstreamSJ_df)] > 1) > 0, ]  %>% pull(transcript_id)
# Take the union of these transcript IDs to create a vector of transcripts to preserve for making the scRNA matrix
int <- Reduce(intersect, list(tpm_filt, sjuniq_filt, ds_filt))
# Save the tpm_df matrix for later 

# Remove monoexonic transcripts to improve specificity 
monoexonic <- read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/group_1/assembled/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv") %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon == 1) %>% pull(transcript_id)
fin_tx <- int[int %!in% monoexonic]
# Load the TE annotation to have a conversion of transcripts to genes 
anno <- read_gff(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/group_1/assembled/TE_transcript_consensus.filtered.with_gene_annotation.gtf") %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(type == "transcript") %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, gene_name) %>% distinct(transcript_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
# Create a data frame to hold the filtered quantification values
quant_df <- data.frame(gene_name = unique(anno$gene_name))
# Using this vector of filtered transcripts, load in the quantification data from TEProf3 and convert to a usable format 
for (i in seq_along(teprof3_output_dirs)){
  #i <- 1
  # Load in the complete quantification file
  quant_file <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/group_%s/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.tsv.gz", i))
  # Separate the TE and non-TE transcripts into individual data frames and filter the TE transcripts for those selected above
  nonte <- quant_file %>% filter(grepl("ENST", transcript_id))
  te <- quant_file %>% filter(!grepl("ENST", transcript_id)) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% fin_tx)
  # Recombine the quantification data frames, join with the annotation information (transcript-gene matching), sum the total counts on a per-gene basis, and pivot wider
  quant_file_sel <- bind_rows(nonte, te) %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, sample, raw_count) %>% left_join(., anno) %>% group_by(sample, gene_name) %>%
                      summarise(total_counts = sum(raw_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = total_counts)
  quant_df <- left_join(quant_df, quant_file_sel)
}
# Save the resultant matrix
mat <- quant_df %>% column_to_rownames(var = "gene_name")
rm(quant_df)
saveRDS(mat, file = sprintf("%s/scrna/quant_mat_20260128.rds", rds_path))

# Repeat this process for tpm values 
tpm_l <- data.frame(transcript_id = anno$transcript_id) 
for (i in seq_along(teprof3_output_dirs)){
  #i <- 1
  # Load in the complete quantification file
  quant_file <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_quant/group_%s/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.tsv.gz", i))
  tpm_samp_df <- quant_file %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id, stringtie_tpm, stringtie_sample) %>% mutate(sample = str_replace(stringtie_sample, "_Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.stats", "")) %>% dplyr::select(-(stringtie_sample)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = stringtie_tpm)
  # Separate the TE and non-TE transcripts into individual data frames and filter the TE transcripts for those selected above
  nonte <- tpm_samp_df %>% filter(grepl("ENST", transcript_id))
  te <- tpm_samp_df %>% filter(!grepl("ENST", transcript_id)) %>% filter(transcript_id %in% fin_tx)
  # Recombine the quantification data frames, join with the annotation information (transcript-gene matching), sum the total counts on a per-gene basis, and pivot wider
  all_tpm <- bind_rows(nonte, te) 
  tpm_l <- left_join(tpm_l, all_tpm)
} 
```

## Step 2: Run the preprocessing scripts on the matrix/Seurat object following the classic pipeline

-   In this step, the Seurat object is generated, and the preprocessing functions listed at the top of the script are run to perform QC, normalization, and dimensionality reduction

```{r, scRNA Preprocessing Step 2, echo = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(scCustomize)
######################################################
# Read in the matrix object and create a Seurat object
######################################################
mat <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/scrna/quant_mat_20260128.rds", rds_path))
# Create a Seurat object from the matrix, filtering for genes expressed in at least 100 cells (~1%)
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, min.cells = 100)
rm(mat)
# Run the preprocessing function
pp_obj <- preprocess_seurat(obj)
rm(obj)
# Plot QC
plot_QC(pp_obj, obj_name = "TEProf3_quant")
# Filter the object to remove the MAD outliers 
filt_obj <- filter_object(pp_obj)
rm(pp_obj)
# Normalize and scale the data 
# sct_obj <- SCTransform(filt_obj, variable.features.n = 10000)
nvfs_obj <- NormalizeData(filt_obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1E5)
rm(filt_obj)
nvfs_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(nvfs_obj, nfeatures = 10000)
nvfs_obj <- ScaleData(nvfs_obj, features = rownames(nvfs_obj))
# Calculate a PCA embedding of the scaled data, using a custom function because the Seurat v5 implementation is goofed because of irlba issues 
pca_obj <- calcPCA(nvfs_obj)
rm(nvfs_obj)
DimPlot(pca_obj, reduction = "pca")
# Calculate tSNE, UMAP, and densMAP embeddings of this object
red_obj <- calc_embeddings(pca_obj)
rm(pca_obj)
# Save this object 
saveRDS(red_obj, file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_dimreduc_%s.rds", rds_path, date))

# Load in the created object and plot epigenetic derepression and p53 response element activity
library(UCell)
obj <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/scrna/teprof3_dimreduc_20260203.rds", rds_path))
hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
# Create scores from the inflammatory response and interferon response pathways to plot a score in the dimreduc embedding
h_inflammatory <- hallmark %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("INFLAMMATORY", gs_name)) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
h_inflammatory <- h_inflammatory[h_inflammatory %in% rownames(flt_obj)]
h_ifa <- hallmark %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("INTERFERON_ALPHA", gs_name)) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
h_ifa <- h_ifa[h_ifa %in% rownames(flt_obj)]
h_ifg <- hallmark %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("INTERFERON_GAMMA", gs_name)) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
h_ifg <- h_ifg[h_ifg %in% rownames(flt_obj)]
vec_list <- list(h_inflammatory, h_ifa, h_ifg)
names(vec_list) <- c("Hallmark_Inflammatory", "Hallmark_Interferon_Alpha", "Hallmark_Interferon_Gamma")
# Join the object layers prior to adding the module score
```

# scCUT&TAG Preprocessing

## Step 1: Data import and analysis in ArchR

-   I initially planned to use ArchR for all of the analysis of this dataset, but did not like the plotting defaults and syntax, so I only do the initial import, matrix generation, and dimensionality reduction using ArchR and import this into Signac/Seurat for plotting and visualization

```{r, scCUT&TAG Step 1, echo = FALSE}
library(reticulate)
library(leiden)
library(data.table)
library(Matrix)
library(irlba)
library(Rtsne)
library(RANN)
library(igraph)
library(uwot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ensembldb)
library(AnnotationHub)
library(plyranges)
###################
# Analysis in ArchR
###################
# This isn't working well. Let's try importing via ArchR instead (quite different framework)
library(ArchR)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
# addArchRLocking(locking = TRUE)
set.seed(1234)
# Create a custom gene annotation using the TEProf3-generated annotations 
# Load in the TEProf3 annotations and make a TxDb object 
# Load the bulk filtered annotation to pull the IDs of the filtered transcripts 
sel_tx <- read_gff(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/bulk_filtered_assembly_20251217.gtf") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  pull(transcript_id) %>% 
  unique
# Load the complete annotation to make the TxDb object
comp_anno <- read_gff(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/20251215_TEProf3_rerun/bulk_assembly/assembled/TE_transcript_consensus.filtered.with_gene_annotation.gtf")
teprof3_txdb <- makeTxDbFromGRanges(comp_anno)

# Make a custom annotation for ArchR
sel_anno <- comp_anno
genes_gr <- sel_anno[sel_anno$type == "gene"]
genes_gr$symbol <- genes_gr$gene_name

exons_gr <- sel_anno[sel_anno$type == "exon"]
exons_gr$symbol <- exons_gr$gene_name
tss_gr <- resize(genes_gr, width = 1, fix = "start")


geneAnno <- createGeneAnnotation(
  TxDb = teprof3_txdb,
  genes = genes_gr,
  exons = exons_gr, 
  TSS = tss_gr, 
)

# Load in the BSgenome annotation and create a custom blacklist
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
bl <- read_bed(file="/scratch/devtools/cmccornack/genomes/hg38.blacklist.bed")
genomeAnno <- createGenomeAnnotation(genome = BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38, blacklist = bl)
me3_files <- list.files("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/CUTTag/arrow_files/", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "me3")
ac_files <- list.files("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/CUTTag/arrow_files/", full.names = TRUE, pattern = "ac")
me3_archr <- ArchRProject(ArrowFiles = me3_files,
                          outputDirectory = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/data_objects/scCUTTag/me3_ArchR",
                          copyArrows = TRUE, 
                          geneAnnotation = geneAnno,
                          genomeAnnotation = genomeAnno, 
                          showLogo = FALSE)
ac_archr <- ArchRProject(ArrowFiles = ac_files,
                         outputDirectory = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/data_objects/scCUTTag/ac_ArchR",
                         copyArrows = TRUE, 
                         geneAnnotation = geneAnno,
                         genomeAnnotation = genomeAnno, 
                         showLogo = FALSE)

# Add peakset and peak matrix
me3_peaks <- readr::read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/CUTTag/H3K27me3_all_peaks.bed",
                               col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "fold_enrichment", "neg_log10_pvalue", "neg_log10_qvalue", "summit")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(seqnames, "_", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  # Filter bottom quartile of enrichment and significance
  dplyr::filter(fold_enrichment > quantile(fold_enrichment, 0.25),
                neg_log10_pvalue > quantile(neg_log10_pvalue, 0.25)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(id = str_c(seqnames, start, end)) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
  as_granges %>% 
  reduce_ranges()
me3_archr <- addPeakSet(ArchRProj = me3_archr, peakSet = me3_peaks)
me3_archr <- addPeakMatrix(me3_archr, binarize = FALSE)
me3_archr <- addFeatureMatrix(input = me3_archr, 
                              features = me3_peaks,
                              matrixName = "FeatureMatrix", 
                              threads = 1)
saveArchRProject(me3_archr)

ac_peaks <- readr::read_delim(file = "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/scrna/CUTTag/H3K27ac_all_peaks.bed",
                              col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand", "fold_enrichment", "neg_log10_pvalue", "neg_log10_qvalue", "summit")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(seqnames, "_", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("chrM", seqnames)) %>% 
  # Filter bottom quartile of enrichment and significance
  dplyr::filter(fold_enrichment > quantile(fold_enrichment, 0.25),
                neg_log10_pvalue > quantile(neg_log10_pvalue, 0.25)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(id = str_c(seqnames, start, end)) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
  as_granges %>% 
  reduce_ranges()
```

```{r, scCUT&TAG Step 2, echo = FALSE}

archr_to_seurat <- function(archR_project, fragment_file){
  # archR_project <- ac_archr
  # Adapted from https://github.com/maggiebr0wn/ArchR-to-Seurat/blob/main/archR2seurat.R
  
  # Pull the Raw Peak counts information
  raw_peak_mat <- getMatrixFromProject(
    ArchRProj = archR_project,
    useMatrix = "PeakMatrix",
    useSeqnames = NULL,
    verbose = TRUE,
    binarize = FALSE,
    threads = getArchRThreads(),
    logFile = createLogFile("getMatrixFromProject")
  )

  pmat <- raw_peak_mat@assays@data$PeakMat
  colnames(pmat) <- colnames(raw_peak_mat)

  chr <- raw_peak_mat@rowRanges@seqnames
  start <- data.frame(raw_peak_mat@rowRanges@ranges)$start
  end <- data.frame(raw_peak_mat@rowRanges@ranges)$end

  rownames(pmat) <- paste(chr, paste(start, end, sep = "-"), sep = ":")

  # Pull the metadata and sort to match the object order
  metadata <- getCellColData(
    ArchRProj = archR_project
  )

  metadata$Barcodes <- rownames(metadata)

  sorted_metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(pmat), metadata$Barcodes),]
  
  # Make an assay and Seurat object of the raw counts and metadata 
  # peaks_assay <- CreateAssayObject(counts = pmat)
  peaks_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(counts = pmat, 
                                      genome = "hg38", 
                                      annotation = comp_anno, 
                                      sep = c(":", "-"), 
                                      fragments = fragment_file)

  seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = peaks_assay,
    assay = "PeakMatrix"
  )
  
  # Make an assay for TE information for the CoveragePlot 
  sorted_metadata <- metadata[match(rownames(seurat_obj@meta.data), rownames(metadata)),] %>% as.data.frame

  seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(object = seurat_obj, metadata = sorted_metadata)

  lsi_mat <- getReducedDims(archR_project, reducedDims = "IterativeLSI_PeakMat", returnMatrix = TRUE)
  lsi_dr <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = lsi_mat,
  key = "LSI_",
  assay = DefaultAssay(seurat_obj)
  )
  
  seurat_obj[["lsi"]] <- lsi_dr
  
  # Add UMAP coords
  umap_coords <- getEmbedding(ArchRProj = archR_project, embedding = "UMAP_PeakMat", returnDF = TRUE)
  umap_coords <- umap_coords[match(colnames(pmat), rownames(umap_coords)),]
  # Make sure the umap coords are in the Seurat object
  mat_umap_coords <- as.matrix(umap_coords)
  mat_umap_coords <- mat_umap_coords[rownames(mat_umap_coords) %in% colnames(seurat_obj), ]
  umap <- CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = mat_umap_coords, assay = "PeakMatrix")

  seurat_obj[["ArchR_UMAP"]] <- umap
  
  # Return seurat object
  return(seurat_obj)
}
```
