```{r, Figure 1B, echo = FALSE}
###################
# Data generation #
###################
# First, pull the top enriched ATAC-seq regions from the samples 
pull_top_atac <- function(sample_name, n = Inf){
  #sample_name <- "A549"
  #n <- 50
  # Read in the sample data frame
  df <- read.csv(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_atac_joint_counts_DAR.csv", outputs_path, sample_name)) %>% dplyr::select(-X)
  # Create an empty list to hold the comparison outs
  comp_list <- list()
  comparisons <- c("WTDPvWTCTRL", "KODPvKOCTRL")
  # Make a list of the top 50 most significantly differentially-accessible regions for all comparisons
  for(i in seq_along(comparisons)){
    #i <- 1
   comp_list[[i]] <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, sample_name, comparisons[[i]])) %>%
                      as.data.frame() %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) %>% filter(padj < 0.01) %>% arrange(padj) %>% 
                      { if(nrow(.) > 0) dplyr::slice(., 1:min(n, nrow(.))) else . } %>%
                      rownames_to_column(var = sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)) %>% pull(sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name))
  }
  # Flatten the list and select unique instances
  regions_flat <- comp_list %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  # Filter the complete ATAC dataframe for these regions
  df_sel <- df %>% filter(region_name %in% regions_flat)
  # Pull the columns that contain accessibility information and convert to a GRanges object to easily compute overlaps with other cell lines
  gr <- df_sel %>% dplyr::select(region_name, contains("BRep")) %>%
              separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE)
  colnames(gr)[1] <- sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)
  gr <- gr %>% as_granges()
  return(gr)
}
```

-   Figure 1C: CpG Methylation density plots in all cell lines and p53 conditions over up DARs and up non-DARs
-   Figure S2H: Same as F1C but over down DARs and down nDARs
-   Figures S2I-J: Violin plots of CpG methylation density over up- and down-DARs that overlap TEs, split by control and treatment, with KO cells in S2I and WT cells in S2J

```{r, echo = FALSE}
###################
# Data generation #
###################
dar_files <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/atac", outputs_path), pattern = "sample_te_p53_overlap_20260212", full.names = TRUE) 
dar_df <- lapply(dar_files, read.csv)
for(i in seq_along(dar_files)){
  # i <- 1
  # Pull all the names/labels for labeing the .bed files 
  fn <- basename(dar_files[[i]])
  cell_line <- fn %>% str_split_i(., "_", 1)
  comp <- fn %>% str_split_i(., "_", 4)
  comp1_name <- comp %>% str_split_i(., "v", 1)
  comp2_name <- comp %>% str_split_i(., "v", 2)
  # Load in the .csv file and separate 
  sel_file <- dar_df[[i]]
  # Up DARS
  up_dar <- subset(sel_file, sel_file[[13]] == "Up") %>% select(seqnames, start, end) %>% as_granges
  seqlevels(up_dar) <- sort(seqlevels(up_dar))
  up_dar <- sort(up_dar)
  write_bed(up_dar, file = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_%s_Up_DARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_line, comp))
  # Up non-DARs
  up_ndar <- subset(sel_file, is.na(sel_file[[13]])) %>% subset(., .[[7]] > 0) %>% select(seqnames, start, end) %>% as_granges
  seqlevels(up_ndar) <- sort(seqlevels(up_ndar))
  up_ndar <- sort(up_ndar)
  write_bed(up_ndar, file = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_%s_Up_nDARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_line, comp))
  # Down DARS
  down_dar <- subset(sel_file, sel_file[[13]] == "Down") %>% select(seqnames, start, end) %>% as_granges
  seqlevels(down_dar) <- sort(seqlevels(down_dar))
  down_dar <- sort(down_dar)
  write_bed(down_dar, file = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_%s_Down_DARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_line, comp))
  # Down non-DARs
  down_ndar <- subset(sel_file, is.na(sel_file[[13]])) %>% subset(., .[[7]] < 0) %>% select(seqnames, start, end) %>% as_granges
  seqlevels(down_ndar) <- sort(seqlevels(down_ndar))
  down_ndar <- sort(down_ndar)
  write_bed(down_ndar, file = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_%s_Down_nDARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_line, comp))
}

# Overlap these .bed files with the methylC files
cell_lines <- c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116")
read_bed_as_granges <- function(path, ...) {
  read_delim(file = path, col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), ...) %>%
    dplyr::select(1:3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(ATAC_id = str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% 
    as_granges()
  }
calc_overlap_mean_methylation <- function(dar_file, methyl_file, ...){
  join_overlap_left(dar_file, methyl_file) %>% 
          as.data.frame %>% 
          distinct(CpG_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
          group_by(ATAC_id) %>% 
          summarise(DP = mean(DP, na.rm = TRUE), CTRL = mean(CTRL, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
          pivot_longer(cols = c(DP, CTRL),
                     names_to = "Condition",
                     values_to = "Methylation_level")
}
# KO-T v. Ctrl
for (i in seq_along(cell_lines)){
  # i <- 1
  # Load in the WGBS file
  methyl_bed <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/wgbs/%s_KO_20260407.bed", outputs_path, cell_lines[[i]])) %>% 
                  rename("seqnames" = "chr") %>% 
                  mutate(CpG_id = str_c(seqnames, start, end, sep = ":")) %>% 
                  as_granges()
  # Load in the DAR and nDAR files
  up_dar <- read_bed_as_granges(path = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_KODPvKOCTRL_Up_DARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_lines[[i]]))
  up_ndar <- read_bed_as_granges(path = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_KODPvKOCTRL_Up_nDARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_lines[[i]]))
  down_dar <- read_bed_as_granges(path = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_KODPvKOCTRL_Down_DARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_lines[[i]]))
  down_ndar <- read_bed_as_granges(path = sprintf("%s/atac/bed/%s_KODPvKOCTRL_Down_nDARs.bed", outputs_path, cell_lines[[i]]))
  # Overlap the files and calculate the mean methylation in DP and CTRL samples over the ATAC region 
  udw <- calc_overlap_mean_methylation(up_dar, methyl_bed) %>% mutate(regions = "Up_DAR", cell_line = cell_lines[[i]], p53 = "KO")
  undw <- calc_overlap_mean_methylation(up_ndar, methyl_bed) %>% mutate(regions = "Up_nDAR", cell_line = cell_lines[[i]], p53 = "KO")
  ddw <- calc_overlap_mean_methylation(down_dar, methyl_bed) %>% mutate(regions = "Down_DAR", cell_line = cell_lines[[i]], p53 = "KO")
  dndw <- calc_overlap_mean_methylation(down_ndar, methyl_bed) %>% mutate(regions = "Down_nDAR", cell_line = cell_lines[[i]], p53 = "KO")
  # Join all of these together
  joint_df <- bind_rows(udw, undw, ddw, dndw)
  # Make a list that has these individual data frames and a joint data frame for plotting 
  df_list <- list(udw, undw, ddw, dndw, joint_df)
  names(df_list) <- c("Up_DAR_WGBS_overlap", "Up_nDAR_WGBS_overlap", "Down_DAR_WGBS_overlap", "Down_nDAR_WGBS_overlap", "All_regions_overlap")
  # Save to an RDS object
  saveRDS(df_list, file = sprintf("%s/wgbs/%s_KODPvKOCTRL_DAR_WGBS_overlap.rds", rds_path, cell_lines[[i]]))
}
```

```{r, Figure 1D ,echo = FALSE}
complete_sample <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/all_cell_line_intersect_rmsk_20260331.rds", rds_path)) %>% dplyr::select(contains("BRep"), "subfamily", "class")

colnames(te_sum) <- c("Class", "Frequency")

te_color_mapping <- c("LINE" = "#FF8E56", "SINE" = "#DB544D", "LTR" = "#528C4C", "DNA" = "#7896EE")
```

### Figure 1E: Epitherapy DAR motif enrichment

```{r, Figure 1E, echo = FALSE}
##########################################################################################
# F1E/SF2H: ATAC-seq motif enrichment of treated v. untreated cells (all DARs and TE-DARs)
##########################################################################################

###################
# Data generation #
###################
# Export the individual cell line DARs from treated v. untreated comparisons for HOMER
# For all DAR motif enrichment, foreground is DARs, background is all peaks
pull_top_atac_homer <- function(sample_name, comparison, n = Inf) {
  # Read input files
  df  <- read.csv(sprintf("%s/atac/%s_atac_joint_counts_DAR.csv", outputs_path, sample_name)) %>%
           dplyr::select(-X)
  rds <- readRDS(sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, sample_name, comparison)) %>%
           as.data.frame() %>%
           filter(padj < 0.01) %>%
           arrange(padj) %>%
           rownames_to_column(var = "region_name")

  # Filter by fold-change direction and take top n
  top_regions <- function(data, fc_direction) {
    filtered <- if (fc_direction == "up") filter(data, log2FoldChange >  1) else
                                          filter(data, log2FoldChange < -1)
    if (nrow(filtered) == 0) return(character(0))
    filtered %>% slice(1:min(n, nrow(.))) %>% pull(region_name)
  }

  regions_up   <- top_regions(rds, "up")
  regions_down <- top_regions(rds, "down")
  regions_all  <- c(regions_up, regions_down)

  # Convert region names to BED-format data frame
  regions_to_bed <- function(region_names) {
    df %>%
      filter(region_name %in% region_names) %>%
      separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"),
               sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>%
      arrange(seqnames, start, end) %>%
      mutate(
        ID     = str_c(sample_name, comparison, seqnames, start, end, sep = ":"),
        empty  = NA,
        strand = "*"
      )
  }

  # Write up, down, and background BED files for the sample and comparison
  write_tsv(regions_to_bed(regions_up),
            sprintf("%s/atac/homer_20260410/%s_%s_Up_DARs.bed", outputs_path, sample_name, comparison),
            col_names = FALSE)
  write_tsv(regions_to_bed(regions_down),
            sprintf("%s/atac/homer_20260410/%s_%s_Down_DARs.bed", outputs_path, sample_name, comparison),
            col_names = FALSE)
  write_tsv(regions_to_bed(df$region_name[df$region_name %!in% regions_all]),
            sprintf("%s/atac/homer_20260410/%s_%s_bkgd.bed", outputs_path, sample_name, comparison),
            col_names = FALSE)
}

# Load in the HOMER output files for plotting
homer_dirs <- list.files(path = sprintf("%s/atac/homer_20260410", outputs_path), pattern = 'gcNorm', full.names = TRUE) %>%
                str_subset(., "p53|TE", negate = TRUE)
homer_outs <- lapply(homer_dirs, function(dir) {
  file_path <- file.path(dir, "knownResults.txt")
  read_delim(file_path) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_name = basename(dir),
      rank        = rank(`Log P-value`, ties.method = "min"),
      top_label   = if_else(rank <= 2, "TopN", "Other")
    )
})
# Bind the loaded results
homer_bound <- bind_rows(homer_outs) %>%
                dplyr::select(-contains("# of Target"), -contains("# of Background")) %>%
                mutate(
                  cell_line  = str_split_i(sample_name, "_", 1),
                  comparison = str_split_i(sample_name, "_", 2),
                  direction  = str_split_i(sample_name, "_", 3),
                ) %>%
                mutate(
                  percent_target_w_motif     = parse_number(`% of Target Sequences with Motif`),
                  percent_background_w_motif = parse_number(`% of Background Sequences with Motif`),
                  percent_diff               = percent_target_w_motif - percent_background_w_motif,
                  clean_motif                = str_split_i(`Motif Name`, "/", 1)
                )
# Make plots for the KODPvKOCTRL and WTDPvWTCTRL and align the y-axis
homer_res_DP <- homer_bound %>%
                  group_by(`Motif Name`) %>%
                  dplyr::filter(any(top_label == "TopN"), comparison %in% c("KODPvKOCTRL", "WTDPvWTCTRL"))

fill_limits <- range(homer_res_DP$percent_target_w_motif, na.rm = TRUE)

# 20261019
# Set the order of the plot based on percent_target_w_motif
motif_order <- homer_res_DP %>%
  group_by(clean_motif) %>%
  summarise(score = mean(percent_target_w_motif, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(score) %>%
  pull(clean_motif)

make_homer_plot <- function(data, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes(y = factor(clean_motif), x = factor(cell_line))) + 
    geom_tile(aes(fill = percent_target_w_motif)) + 
    geom_point(aes(size = -`Log P-value`, color = -`Log P-value` > 2)) + 
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = fill_limits) + 
    scale_size(range = c(0, 4), 
               limits = c(0, max(homer_res_DP$`Log P-value` * -1) %>% round), 
               name = expression(paste("-log"[10], "(p-value)"))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "grey80", "FALSE" = NA), 
                       name = "Significance", 
                       breaks = "TRUE", 
                       labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant")) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = motif_order) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 6),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 6), 
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8)
    ) +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(direction), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    ggtitle(title) +
    xlab("Cell Line") + ylab("HOMER Motif")
}
KODP_motifs <- homer_res_DP %>% filter(comparison == "KODPvKOCTRL") %>% make_homer_plot(., "KO DP v. CTRL")
WTDP_motifs <- homer_res_DP %>% filter(comparison == "WTDPvWTCTRL") %>% make_homer_plot(., "WT DP v. CTRL") + theme(axis.text.y  = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
combined_plot <- KODP_motifs + WTDP_motifs + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = unit(c(1, 1), "null"), axis = "collect", guides = "collect")

pdf(file = sprintf("%s/F1E_all_DAR_motif_analysis.pdf", final_plots_path), width = 6, height = 6.41)
print(combined_plot)
dev.off()
```

### Figure 1F: ATAC GSEA results (Hallmark pathways)

```{r, Figure 1F, echo = FALSE}
###################
# Data generation #
###################
library(ChIPseeker)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
# For each sample, make a heatmap of the DARs to pull the kmeans information and then run GSEA on the associated genes
# Load Hallmark gene sets 
gene_sets_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = 'Homo sapiens', collection = 'H')
# Convert the data frame into a list
gene_sets <- gene_sets_df %>% split(x = .$ncbi_gene, f = .$gs_name)
get_anno <- function(obj) obj@anno 

res_df <- data.frame()
make_sample_atac_gsea <- function(sample_name, n = Inf){
  # sample_name <- "A549"
  
  # Load the dds object
  dds <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_dds_obj.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  shrink <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr")
  
  # Read in the sample DESeq2 results
  ko <- shrink %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
          # Convert to GRanges for labeling
          rownames_to_column(var = "region_name") %>% 
          separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE) %>% 
          as_granges() %>% 
          # Label and convert back to GRanges before filtering for promoters and arranging by padj
          annotatePeak(., TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene,
                             level = "gene",
                             tssRegion = c(-5000, 1000)) %>% 
          get_anno %>% 
          as.data.frame %>% 
          # Do light filtering to remove NAs from downstream GSEA
          filter(!is.na(geneId), !is.na(padj)) %>% 
          # Use a signed-rank score (preserve magnitude of log2FC while adjusting for significance so it's not overblown by strong peaks)
          mutate(signed_score = -log10(padj) * log2FoldChange) %>% 
          # Take the region that is the minimum distance from the TSS (selecting for promoters essentially)
          group_by(geneId) %>% 
          slice_min(abs(distanceToTSS), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
          # Select the Gene ID and signed score columns for GSEA and arrange
          dplyr::select(geneId, signed_score) %>% 
          arrange(desc(signed_score))
          
  shrink <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr")
  wt <- shrink %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
          # Convert to GRanges for labeling
          rownames_to_column(var = "region_name") %>% 
          separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE) %>% 
          as_granges() %>% 
          # Label and convert back to GRanges before filtering for promoters and arranging by padj
          annotatePeak(., TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene,
                             level = "gene",
                             tssRegion = c(-5000, 1000)) %>% 
          get_anno %>% 
          as.data.frame %>% 
          # Do light filtering to remove NAs from downstream GSEA
          filter(!is.na(geneId), !is.na(padj)) %>% 
          # Use a signed-rank score (preserve magnitude of log2FC while adjusting for significance so it's not overblown by strong peaks)
          mutate(signed_score = -log10(padj) * log2FoldChange) %>% 
          # Take the region that is the minimum distance from the TSS (selecting for promoters essentially)
          group_by(geneId) %>% 
          slice_min(abs(distanceToTSS), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
          # Select the Gene ID and signed score columns for GSEA and arrange
          dplyr::select(geneId, signed_score) %>% 
          arrange(desc(signed_score))
  
  # Run GSEA and format the outputs 
  ko_rank <- setNames(ko$signed_score, ko$geneId)
  res_ko <- fgsea::fgsea(gene_sets, ko_rank, nPermSimple = 10000) %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(padj) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, padj, NES) %>% mutate(cell = sample_name, p53 = "KO")

  wt_rank <- setNames(wt$signed_score, wt$geneId)
  res_wt <- fgsea::fgsea(gene_sets, wt_rank, nPermSimple = 10000) %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(padj) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, padj, NES) %>% mutate(cell = sample_name, p53 = "WT")
  # res_wt
  
  res_df <- bind_rows(res_df, res_ko, res_wt)

return(res_df)
}
```

```{r, Figures S2B-E, scho = FALSE}
pull_top_atac_wtt <- function(sample_name, n = Inf){
  #sample_name <- "A549"
  #n <- 50
  # Read in the sample data frame
  df <- read.csv(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_atac_joint_counts_DAR.csv", outputs_path, sample_name)) %>% dplyr::select(-X)
  # Create an empty list to hold the comparison outs
  comp_list <- list()
  comparisons <- c("WTDPvWTCTRL")
  # Make a list of the top 50 most significantly differentially-accessible regions for all comparisons
  for(i in seq_along(comparisons)){
    #i <- 1
   comp_list[[i]] <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, sample_name, comparisons[[i]])) %>%
                      as.data.frame() %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) %>% filter(padj < 0.01) %>% arrange(padj) %>% 
                      { if(nrow(.) > 0) slice(., 1:min(n, nrow(.))) else . } %>%
                      rownames_to_column(var = sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)) %>% pull(sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name))
  }
  # Flatten the list and select unique instances
  regions_flat <- comp_list %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  # Filter the complete ATAC dataframe for these regions
  df_sel <- df %>% filter(region_name %in% regions_flat)
  # Pull the columns that contain accessibility information and convert to a GRanges object to easily compute overlaps with other cell lines
  gr <- df_sel %>% dplyr::select(region_name, contains("BRep")) %>%
              separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE)
  colnames(gr)[1] <- sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)
  gr <- gr %>% as_granges()
  return(gr)
}
gr_wtt <- map(c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116"), pull_top_atac_wtt)

# Do a series of joins to get the counts for the Euler plot 
subtract_overlaps <- function(query, subject) {
  hits <- findOverlaps(query, subject, type = "any")
  if (length(hits) > 0) query[-queryHits(hits)] else query
}

euler_joins <- function(gr_top_atac_output, plot_name, file_name){
  # gr_top_atac_output <- gr_ctrl
  # file_name <- "WTCTRLvKOCTRL"
  A549 <- gr_top_atac_output[[1]]
  RKO <- gr_top_atac_output[[2]]
  HCT116 <- gr_top_atac_output[[3]]
  # Pairwise joins
  A549_RKO <- join_overlap_inner(A549, RKO)
  RKO_HCT <- join_overlap_inner(RKO, HCT116)
  A549_HCT <- join_overlap_inner(A549, HCT116)
  # All joint
  all_joint <- join_overlap_inner(A549_RKO, A549_HCT)
  # Remove the pairwise and joint overlaps from the individual and pairwise
  # Pairwise
  A549_RKO <- subtract_overlaps(A549_RKO, all_joint)
  RKO_HCT <- subtract_overlaps(RKO_HCT, all_joint)
  A549_HCT <- subtract_overlaps(A549_HCT, all_joint)
  # Single 
  A549 <- subtract_overlaps(A549, c(all_joint, A549_RKO, A549_HCT))
  RKO <- subtract_overlaps(RKO, c(all_joint, A549_RKO, RKO_HCT))
  HCT116 <- subtract_overlaps(HCT116, c(all_joint, A549_HCT, RKO_HCT))
  # Make a data frame that contains the counts of the GenomicRanges intervals of these calculated overlaps 
  euler_l <- euler(c("A549" = A549 %>% length, "RKO" = RKO %>% length, "HCT116" = HCT116 %>% length,
    "A549&RKO" = A549_RKO %>% length, "A549&HCT116" = A549_HCT %>% length, "RKO&HCT116" = RKO_HCT %>% length, 
    "A549&RKO&HCT116" = all_joint %>% length))
  euler_p <- plot(euler_l,
             quantities = TRUE,
             labels = c("A549", "HCT116", "RKO"),
             # main = sprintf("%s Overlapping DARs", plot_name),
             fills = list(fill = c("#62b045", "#b13ba7", "#b7b247"), alpha = 0.5))
  # Print the euler plot to a file
  pdf(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_DAR_euler.pdf", plots_path, file_name), width = 2, height = 2)
  print(euler_p)
  dev.off()
}
euler_joins(gr_wtt, "WT Trt v. Ctrl", "WTDPvWTCTRL")
euler_joins(gr_kot, "KO Trt v. Ctrl", "KODPvKOCTRL")
euler_joins(gr_ctrl, "WT Ctrl v. KO Ctrl", "WTCTRLvKOCTRL")
euler_joins(gr_dp, "WT Trt v. KO Trt", "WTDPvKODP")
```

### Figure S2G: Genomic localization of DARs

```{r, Figure S2G, echo = FALSE}
pull_top_atac <- function(sample_name, n = Inf){
  #sample_name <- "A549"
  #n <- 50
  # Read in the sample data frame
  df <- read.csv(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_atac_joint_counts_DAR.csv", outputs_path, sample_name)) %>% dplyr::select(-X)
  # Create an empty list to hold the comparison outs
  comp_list <- list()
  comparisons <- c("WTCTRLvKOCTRL", "WTDPvKODP")
  # Make a list of the top n most significantly differentially-accessible regions for all comparisons
  for(i in seq_along(comparisons)){
    #i <- 1
   comp_list[[i]] <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s_%s.rds", rds_path, sample_name, comparisons[[i]])) %>%
                      as.data.frame() %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>% arrange(padj) %>% 
                      { if(nrow(.) > 0) dplyr::slice(., 1:min(n, nrow(.))) else . } %>%
                      rownames_to_column(var = sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)) %>% pull(sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name))
  }
  # Flatten the list and select unique instances
  regions_flat <- comp_list %>% unlist() %>% unique()
  # Filter the complete ATAC dataframe for these regions
  df_sel <- df %>% filter(region_name %in% regions_flat)
  # Pull the columns that contain accessibility information and convert to a GRanges object to easily compute overlaps with other cell lines
  gr <- df_sel %>% dplyr::select(region_name, contains("BRep")) %>%
              separate(region_name, into = c("seqnames", "start", "end"), sep = "[:-]", remove = FALSE, convert = TRUE)
  colnames(gr)[1] <- sprintf("%s_region_name", sample_name)
  gr <- gr %>% as_granges()
  return(gr)
}
gr_top_atac <- map(c("A549", "RKO", "HCT116"), pull_top_atac)

# Next, look at the center 250 bp of these regions and pull the overlapping regions between cell lines (as done before, but this time on the counts/reads data frame)
gr1_center <-  mutate(anchor_center(gr_top_atac[[1]]), width = 250)
gr2_center <- mutate(anchor_center(gr_top_atac[[2]]), width = 250)
int1 <- plyranges::join_overlap_inner(gr1_center, gr2_center)
# Overlap these overlapping centers with the third sample
gr3_center <- mutate(anchor_center(gr_top_atac[[3]]), width = 250)
int_all <- plyranges::join_overlap_inner(int1, gr3_center) %>% as.data.frame

# Annotate the joint peakset for genomic regions 
shared_peaks <- int_all %>% dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end) %>% as_granges %>% annotatePeak(., TxDb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene, level = "gene")
anno_stat <- shared_peaks@annoStat %>% 
              as.data.frame %>% 
              mutate(Freq = round(Frequency, 2), label = str_c(Feature, " (", Freq, "%)"))

anno_pal <- DiscretePalette_scCustomize(nrow(anno_stat), palette = "varibow", shuffle = TRUE, seed = 1234)

pc <- ggplot(anno_stat, aes(x = "", y = Frequency, fill = Feature)) + 
        geom_col(color = "black") + coord_polar(theta = "y") + 
        theme_void() + 
        labs(fill = 'Genomic Location of Shared DARs', title = "") + 
        theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20), 
              legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
              legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
              strip.text = element_text(size = 11)) + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = anno_pal, labels = unlist(anno_stat$label))

pdf(file = sprintf("%s/S2G_atac_dar_genomicloc.pdf", final_plots_path), width = 5, height = 4)
print(pc)
dev.off()
```

```{r, Figure 2A, echo = FALSE}
# Repeated code from below to list DEGs in individual cell lines and comparisons
pull_degs <- function(sample_name){
  # sample_name <- "A549"
  rds_obj <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  # Up DEGs
  ko_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  wt_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  dp_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "KO_DP"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  ctrl_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_CTRL", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  # Down DEGs
  ko_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  wt_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  dp_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "KO_DP"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  ctrl_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_CTRL", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  
  dp_ctrl_up <- c(ko_u, wt_u) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "DPvCtrl Up DEG", sample = sample_name)
  dp_ctrl_down <- c(ko_d, wt_d) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "DPvCtrl Down DEG", sample = sample_name)
  wt_ko_up <- c(dp_u, ctrl_u) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "WTvKO Up DEG", sample = sample_name)
  wt_ko_down <- c(dp_d, ctrl_d) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "WTvKO Down DEG", sample = sample_name)

  comp_degs <- bind_rows(dp_ctrl_up, dp_ctrl_down, wt_ko_up, wt_ko_down)
  
return(comp_degs)
}

make_indiv_sample_heatmap_te <- function(counts, degs, plot_title){
  # counts <- A549
  # degs <- A549_degs
  # plot_title <- "A549"
  # Add the TE labels
  complete_sample <- left_join(counts, te_gene_sel, by = c("gene" = "teprof3_gene_name")) %>% left_join(., degs, by = c("gene" = "teprof3_gene_name")) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  # Add DEG labels
  # Remove the gene name column and create the vectors for the top annotation 
  counts <- complete_sample[2:9]
  cell_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(counts)[1:8], "_", 1)
  names(cell_vec) <- colnames(counts)[1:8]
  mut_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(counts)[1:8], "_", 2)
  names(mut_vec) <- colnames(counts)[1:8]
  trt_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(counts)[1:8], "_", 3)
  names(trt_vec) <- colnames(counts)[1:8]
  rep_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(counts)[1:8], "_", 4)
  names(rep_vec) <- colnames(counts)[1:8]

  top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(which = "col",
                                        "Mutation" = mut_vec, "Treatment" = trt_vec, "Replicate" = rep_vec,
                                        col = list("Cell Line" = c('A549' = "#62b045", 'HCT116' = "#b13ba7", 'RKO' = "#b7b247"),
                                                     "Treatment" = c("CTRL" = '#6295d3', "DP" = '#d2542c'),
                                                     "Mutation" = c('KO'  = "#6969d8", 'WT'= "#d29041"), #'KOEV' = "#c570dd", "KOWT" = "#54a26c", "KO175" = "#da5094", "KO273" = "#46c0c0"),
                                                     "Replicate" = c("BRep1" = "#d13f57", "BRep2" = "#77732e")),
                                        annotation_name_gp = gpar(col = NA), gp = gpar(col = "white"),
                                        annotation_legend_param = list(
                                          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                                          labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
                                        )
                                )

  ht1 <- Heatmap(counts,
                   top_annotation = top_anno,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_column_dend = FALSE,
                   show_column_names = FALSE,
                   na_col = "grey",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)),
                   column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"), 
                   column_title = plot_title
                 )
  ht <- draw(ht1)
  # Add the TE annotation on the left side
  tc <- complete_sample$TE_class
  deg <- complete_sample$Type
  # ts <- complete_sample$subfamily
  tc_o <- tc[row_order(ht)]
  deg_o <- deg[row_order(ht)]
  gt_b <- HeatmapAnnotation("TE Class" = tc_o, "DEG" = deg_o, which = "row",
                            col = list("TE Class" = c("LINE" = "#FF8E56", "SINE" = "#DB544D", "LTR" = "#528C4C","DNA" = "#7896EE"), 
                                       "DEG" = c("DPvCtrl Up DEG" = "#b61a0e", "WTvKO Up DEG" = "#fc3d56", "DPvCtrl Down DEG" = "blue", "WTvKO Down DEG" = "#a7d4ff")),
                            annotation_name_gp = gpar(col = NA), gp = gpar(col = "white"),
                            annotation_legend_param = list(
                              title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
                              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)
                            ))
  
  
  ht2 <- draw(gt_b + ht1)
  pdf(file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_indiv_heatmap_te.pdf", plots_path, plot_title), width = 5, height = 6)
  print(ht2)
  dev.off()
}
```

### Figure 2B: RNAseq GSEA results (Hallmark pathways )

```{r, Figure 2B, echo - FALSE}
#############################################
# F2B: Hallmark Pathway FGSEA on RNA-seq data 
#############################################
###################
# Data generation #
###################
# Use the Hallmark pathways 
gene_sets_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = 'Homo sapiens', collection = 'H')
# Convert the data frame into a list
gene_sets <- gene_sets_df %>% 
              # filter(gs_id %in% pathways_of_int) %>% 
              split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)

# Load the dds object
res_df <- list()
# dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
cell_lines <- c("A549", "HCT116", "RKO")
for (i in 1:3){
    dds <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]]
    sample_name <- cell_lines[[i]]
    shrink <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr")
    ko <- shrink %>% as.data.frame()
    shrink <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr")
    wt <- shrink %>% as.data.frame()

    #rl <- sign(ko$log2FoldChange)*(-log10(ko$padj))
    rl <- ko$log2FoldChange
    names(rl) <- rownames(ko)
    rankings <- sort(rl, decreasing = TRUE)
    res_ko <- fgsea::fgsea(gene_sets, rankings) %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(padj) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, padj, NES) %>% mutate(cell = sample_name, p53 = "KO")

    #rl <- sign(wt$log2FoldChange)*(-log10(wt$padj))
    rl <- wt$log2FoldChange
    names(rl) <- rownames(wt)
    rankings <- sort(rl, decreasing = TRUE)
    res_wt <- fgsea::fgsea(gene_sets, rankings) %>% as.data.frame %>% arrange(padj) %>% dplyr::select(pathway, padj, NES) %>% mutate(cell = sample_name, p53 = "WT")

    res_df[[i]] <- bind_rows(res_ko, res_wt) 
}

flat_res <- res_df %>% bind_rows
# Make a comprehensive dataframe of the results for plotting
fgsea_comp <- flat_res %>% group_by(pathway) %>% 
                mutate(log10p = -log10(padj), pathway_rename = str_replace(pathway, "HALLMARK", "") %>% str_replace_all(., "_", " ")) %>% 
                filter(any(padj < 0.05))
saveRDS(fgsea_comp, file = sprintf("%s/rna/fgsea_comp_df.rds", rds_path))

############
# Plotting #
############
max_nes <- max(abs(fgsea_comp$NES), na.rm = TRUE)

# 20261102: Reorder the pathways on the plot to put significant/negative at the topp, and less significant/positive values lower down
ord <- fgsea_comp %>%
  group_by(pathway_rename) %>%
  # Set order by taking the sign of the NES
  summarise(score = sum(pmin(log10p, 10), na.rm = TRUE),
            dir   = sign(mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  pull(pathway_rename)

fgsea_comp <- fgsea_comp %>%
  mutate(pathway_rename = factor(pathway_rename, levels = rev(ord)))

                              scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = NA),

                                legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
                                legend.text = element_text(size = 6),

                              ) + 
                              facet_grid(cols = vars(p53), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
                              xlab("Cell") + ylab("Hallmark Pathway")

                              scale_fill_viridis_c() + 
                              scale_size(range = c(0, 6), limits = c(0, max(fgsea_comp$log10p) %>% round), name = expression(paste("-log"[10], "(padj)"))) +
                              scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = NA), 
                                                 name = "Significance", labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant", 
                                                                                   "FALSE" = "Non-significant")) +
                              theme_bw() +
                                theme(
                                axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 8),
                                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
                                axis.title = element_text(size = , face = "bold"),
                                legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
                                legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
                                strip.text = element_text(size = 8)
                              ) + 
                              facet_grid(cols = vars(p53), scales = "free", space = "free") +
                              xlab("Cell") + ylab("Hallmark Pathway")
```

```{r, Figure 2C, echo = FALSE}
# Repeated code from below to list DEGs in individual cell lines and comparisons
pull_degs <- function(sample_name){
  # sample_name <- "A549"
  rds_obj <- readRDS(file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", rds_path, sample_name))
  # Up DEGs
  ko_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  wt_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  dp_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "KO_DP"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  ctrl_u <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_CTRL", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 1) %>% 
            rownames
  # Down DEGs
  ko_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  wt_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  dp_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "KO_DP"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  ctrl_d <- lfcShrink(rds_obj[[1]], contrast = c("group", "WT_CTRL", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>%
            as.data.frame %>% 
            filter(padj < 0.05  & log2FoldChange < 1) %>% 
            rownames
  
  dp_ctrl_up <- c(ko_u, wt_u) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "DPvCtrl Up DEG", sample = sample_name)
  dp_ctrl_down <- c(ko_d, wt_d) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "DPvCtrl Down DEG", sample = sample_name)
  wt_ko_up <- c(dp_u, ctrl_u) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "WTvKO Up DEG", sample = sample_name)
  wt_ko_down <- c(dp_d, ctrl_d) %>% unique %>% 
                    data.frame("teprof3_gene_name" = .) %>% 
                    left_join(te_gene_sel) %>% 
                    mutate(Type = "WTvKO Down DEG", sample = sample_name)

  comp_degs <- bind_rows(dp_ctrl_up, dp_ctrl_down, wt_ko_up, wt_ko_down)
  
return(comp_degs)
}
```

### Figure 2D: TE class and subfamily expression in epitherapy

```{r, Figure 2D, echo = FALSE}
###################
# Data generation #
###################
# This is too much code I should've reworking this into a function 

library(edgeR)
dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
# Try using the camera function from limma/voom to calculate the expression differences of a group of transcripts (in this case, TE subfamilies)
# Using this because it's more robust/validated than other methods I could employ 
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sel <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, TE_class, TE_family, TE_subfamily, transcript_class) %>% distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
camera_outs <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_along(1:3)){
  # i < - 1
  # Pull the cell line from the dds object for later
  cell_line <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]]@colData$Cell %>% unique
  # First, pull the mean log2FC of the WT DPvCTRL and KO DPvCTRL comparisons at the TE subfamily level
  wt_dpvc_l2fc <- dds_objs[[i]][[6]] %>% 
              #counts(normalized = TRUE) %>% 
              as.data.frame %>% 
              rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
              left_join(., te_anno_sel) %>% 
              drop_na() %>% 
              distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
              group_by(TE_subfamily) %>%
              dplyr::summarize(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ko_dpvc_l2fc <- dds_objs[[i]][[2]] %>% 
              #counts(normalized = TRUE) %>% 
              as.data.frame %>% 
              rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
              left_join(., te_anno_sel) %>% 
              drop_na() %>% 
              distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
              group_by(TE_subfamily) %>%
              dplyr::summarize(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Next, pull the counts from the dds object and import into edgeR for running limma/voom camera function
  expr_mat <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]] %>% counts(normalized = FALSE) 
  dge <- DGEList(counts = expr_mat)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
  
  # Pull the sample names from the expression matrix and make a vector to hold the corresponding conditions (p53 + treatment)
  sample_names <- colnames(expr_mat)
  condition <- paste(str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 2), str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 3), sep = "_")
  
  # Make a design matrix from these conditions to set contrasts later
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + factor(condition))
  colnames(design) <- c("KO_CTRL", "KO_DP", "WT_CTRL", "WT_DP")
  # Transform the counts data using voom and then fit the linear model to the genes
  voom_out <- voom(dge, design, plot = TRUE) 
  fit <- lmFit(voom_out, design)
  
  # Make a design matrix of the contrasts of interest, for this just doing the trt v. ctrl comparisons
  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
    WT_DP_vs_WT_CTRL = WT_DP - WT_CTRL,
    KO_DP_vs_KO_CTRL = KO_DP - KO_CTRL,
    # DP_effect_in_WT = (WT_DP - WT_CTRL) - (KO_DP - KO_CTRL),
    levels = design
  )
  
  # Split the TE annotation by subfamily and TEProf3 gene name, and then filter for TE subfamilies that have >1 observed transcript
  te_anno <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]] %>% 
              counts(normalized = TRUE) %>% 
              as.data.frame %>% 
              rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
              left_join(., te_anno_sel) %>% 
              drop_na() %>% 
              distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
              dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, TE_subfamily, TE_class)
              
  gene_sets <- split(te_anno$teprof3_gene_name, te_anno$TE_subfamily)
  filtered_gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) > 1]
  
  # Pull the indices of these TE subfamilies from the matrix 
  idx <- ids2indices(filtered_gene_sets, identifiers = rownames(expr_mat))
  
  # Run camera to pull the results of subfamily enrichment for these contrasts
  wt_dpvc_cr <- camera(y = voom_out,
                       index = idx,
                       design = design,
                       contrast = contrast_matrix[, "WT_DP_vs_WT_CTRL"],
                       inter.gene.cor = 0.1
                      ) %>% 
                      rownames_to_column("TE_subfamily") %>% 
                      left_join(., wt_dpvc_l2fc) %>% 
                      mutate(cell_line = cell_line, comparison = "WT_DP_v_CTRL")
  
  ko_dpvc_cr <- camera(y = voom_out,
                       index = idx,
                       design = design,
                       contrast = contrast_matrix[, "KO_DP_vs_KO_CTRL"],
                       inter.gene.cor = 0.1
                      ) %>% 
                      rownames_to_column("TE_subfamily") %>% 
                      left_join(., ko_dpvc_l2fc) %>% 
                      mutate(cell_line = cell_line, comparison = "KO_DP_v_CTRL")
  
  # Bind the camera outputs together and output to a data frame for plotting 
  camera_outs <- bind_rows(camera_outs, wt_dpvc_cr) %>% bind_rows(., ko_dpvc_cr)
}
```

```{r, Figure S4A, echo = FALSE}
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)

make_indiv_sample_heatmap <- function(counts, plot_title){
  # counts <- A549_cts
  # plot_title <- "A549"
  # Reorder the columns so that all the control and DP samples are adjacent
  ctrl_indices <- grep("CTRL", colnames(counts))
  dp_indices <- grep("DP", colnames(counts))
  c_cts <- counts[, c(1, ctrl_indices), drop = FALSE]
  dp_cts <- counts[, c(1, dp_indices), drop = FALSE]
  bound_scaled_mat<- full_join(c_cts, dp_cts)
  # Add the TE labels
  te_labels <- te_anno_sel %>% filter(teprof3_gene_name %in% bound_scaled_mat$gene) %>% dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, TE_class, TE_subfamily) %>% rename_with(~ c("gene", "TE_class", "TE_subfamily"))
  complete_sample <- left_join(bound_scaled_mat, te_labels)
  # Remove the gene name column and create the vectors for the top annotation 
  bound_scaled_mat <- bound_scaled_mat[2:9]
  cell_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8], "_", 1)
  names(cell_vec) <- colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8]
  mut_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8], "_", 2)
  names(mut_vec) <- colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8]
  trt_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8], "_", 3)
  names(trt_vec) <- colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8]
  rep_vec <- str_split_i(colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8], "_", 4)
  names(rep_vec) <- colnames(bound_scaled_mat)[1:8]

  top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(which = "col",
                                        "Mutation" = mut_vec, "Treatment" = trt_vec, "Replicate" = rep_vec,
                                        col = list("Cell Line" = c('A549' = "#62b045", 'HCT116' = "#b13ba7", 'RKO' = "#b7b247"),
                                                     "Treatment" = c("CTRL" = '#6295d3', "DP" = '#d2542c'),
                                                     "Mutation" = c('KO'  = "#6969d8", 'WT'= "#d29041"), #'KOEV' = "#c570dd", "KOWT" = "#54a26c", "KO175" = "#da5094", "KO273" = "#46c0c0"),
                                                     "Replicate" = c("BRep1" = "#d13f57", "BRep2" = "#77732e")),
                                        annotation_name_gp = gpar(col = NA), gp = gpar(col = "white"),
                                        annotation_legend_param = list(
                                          title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),  # Applies to all titles
                                          labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)  # Applies to all labels
                                        )
                                )

  ht1 <- Heatmap(bound_scaled_mat,
                   top_annotation = top_anno,
                   cluster_columns = FALSE,
                   show_column_dend = FALSE,
                   show_column_names = FALSE,
                   na_col = "grey",
                   heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)),
                   column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"), 
                   column_title = plot_title
                 )
  ht <- draw(ht1)
  # Add the TE annotation on the left side
  tc <- complete_sample$TE_class
  # ts <- complete_sample$subfamily
  tc_o <- tc[row_order(ht)]
  gt_b <- HeatmapAnnotation("TE Class" = tc_o, which = "row",
                            col = list("TE Class" = c("LINE" = "#FF8E56",
                                                      "SINE" = "#DB544D",
                                                      "LTR" = "#528C4C",
                                                      "DNA" = "#7896EE")),
                            annotation_label = "TE Overlap", annotation_name_rot = 0,
                            annotation_legend_param = list(
                              title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),  # Applies to all titles
                              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)  # Applies to all labels
                            ))
  
  
  ht2 <- draw(gt_b + ht1)
  pdf(file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_indiv_heatmap.pdf", plots_path, plot_title), width = 5, height = 6)
  print(ht2)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r, Figure S4B, echo = FALSE}
#######################################################################################
# Export the TE promoters called on individual cell lines to do similarity measurements

make_indiv_cell_line_te_bed <- function(sample_name){
  # sample_name <- "A549"
  te <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/rna/data/bam/%s/assembled/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", sample_name))
  # Make vectors of the mono and polyexonic TE transcripts 
  mono_te <- te %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon < 2) %>% pull(transcript_id)
  poly_te <- te %>% filter(transcript_total_num_of_exon > 1) %>% pull(transcript_id)
  # Filter using the same parameters as above to make a vector of transcript IDs for plotting 
  quant <- read_tsv(file = sprintf("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/rna/data/bam/%s/assembled/teprof3_output_quantification.TE.tsv.gz", sample_name)) %>%
            filter(grepl("_KO_|_WT_", stringtie_sample)) %>% 
            group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(!all(stringtie_tpm == 0))
  mono_sel <- quant %>% 
                filter(transcript_id %in% mono_te) %>% 
                group_by(transcript_id) %>% 
                filter(any(stringtie_tpm > 5)) %>% 
                pull(transcript_id) %>% 
                unique
  poly_sel <- quant %>% s
                filter(transcript_id %in% poly_te) %>% 
                group_by(transcript_id) %>% 
                filter(any(stringtie_tpm > 2) & 
                         any(perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream > 2) & 
                         any(SJ_uniqlymapped_read_upstream/perfect_SJ_uniqlymapped_read_downstream < 0.5)) %>% 
                pull(transcript_id) %>% 
                unique
  # Pull these transcript IDs from the annotation df and write the TE regiosn toa .bed file
  te_filt <- te %>% 
              filter(transcript_id %in% c(mono_sel, poly_sel)) %>% 
              dplyr::select(TE_chr, TE_start, TE_stop) %>% 
              rename("seqnames" = "TE_chr", "start" = "TE_start", "end" = "TE_stop") %>% 
              as_granges() %>% sort()
  write_bed(te_filt, file = sprintf("%s/rna/%s_te_reg.bed", outputs_path, sample_name))
}

my_cell_fun <- function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                            # Only plot lower triangular (including diagonal)
                            if(i >= j) {
                              # Draw rectangle
                              grid.rect(x, y, width, height, gp = gpar(fill = fill, col = fill))
                              
                              # Get the value and format it
                              value <- sim_matrix[i, j]
                              formatted_value <- sprintf("%.3f", value)  # Using 3 decimals as in your code
                              
                              # Choose text color based on cell fill color (background)
                              # For dark backgrounds, use white text; for light backgrounds, use black
                              if(mean(col2rgb(fill)) < 128) {
                                text_color <- "white"
                              } else {
                                text_color <- "black"
                              }
                              
                              # Add text to cell
                              grid.text(formatted_value, x, y, 
                                        gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = text_color))
                            }
}
```

```{r, Figure 3A, echo=FALSE}
#############################################
# F3A: TE class/subfamily enrichment WT v. KO
#############################################
###################
# Data generation #
###################
library(edgeR)
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sel <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, TE_class, TE_family, TE_subfamily, transcript_class) %>% distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
# Repeat this for WT v KO comparisons for figure 

# Recoded as functions 
# Helper function to compute mean log2FC at a given grouping level
get_mean_l2fc <- function(dds_res, te_anno_sel, group_var) {
  dds_res %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>%
    left_join(., te_anno_sel, by = "teprof3_gene_name") %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_var))) %>%
    summarise(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Helper function to build voom objects with the correct model matrix
build_voom <- function(dds_obj) {
  expr_mat <- dds_obj %>% counts(normalized = FALSE)
  dge <- DGEList(counts = expr_mat) %>% calcNormFactors()
  sample_names <- colnames(expr_mat)
  condition <- factor(
    paste(str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 2), str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 3), sep = "_"),
    levels = c("KO_CTRL", "KO_DP", "WT_CTRL", "WT_DP")
  )
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + condition)
  colnames(design) <- levels(condition)
  voom_out <- voom(dge, design, plot = TRUE)
  list(voom_out = voom_out, design = design, expr_mat = expr_mat)
}

# Function to iterate the camera function over a loop of cell lines and pairwise comparisons
run_camera_loop_wtko <- function(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var, intergene_cor) {
  # Index of DESeq2 result objects: [[3]] = WT_vs_KO_CTRL, [[5]] = WT_vs_KO_DP
  res_idx <- list(ctrl = 3, dp = 5)
  comparisons <- list(ctrl = "WT_vs_KO_CTRL", dp = "WT_vs_KO_DP")
  
  # Instantiate a data frame to hold the outputs 
  camera_outs <- data.frame()
  
  # Iterate along the dds_objects 
  for (i in seq_along(dds_objs)) {
    dds_obj <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]]
    # Pull the cell line information to mutate onto the output data frame 
    cell_line <- dds_obj@colData$Cell %>% unique()
    
    # Compute mean log2FC for each contrast at the level of TE classes or subfamilies using the helper function for the background color in the dotplot 
    l2fc <- list(
      ctrl = get_mean_l2fc(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$ctrl]], te_anno_sel, group_var),
      dp   = get_mean_l2fc(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$dp]],   te_anno_sel, group_var)
    )
    
    # Build voom and design objects using the helper function 
    voom_objs <- build_voom(dds_obj)
    
    # Build gene sets at the specified grouping level
    te_anno_counts <- dds_obj %>%
      counts(normalized = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>%
      left_join(., te_anno_sel, by = "teprof3_gene_name") %>%
      drop_na() %>%
      distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, all_of(group_var))
    
    gene_sets <- split(te_anno_counts$teprof3_gene_name, te_anno_counts[[group_var]])
    filtered_gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) > 1]
    idx <- ids2indices(filtered_gene_sets, identifiers = rownames(voom_objs$expr_mat))
    
    # Build contrast matrix
    contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
      WT_vs_KO_CTRL = WT_CTRL - KO_CTRL,
      WT_vs_KO_DP   = WT_DP   - KO_DP,
      levels = voom_objs$design
    )
    
    # Run camera for each contrast and join mean log2FC information for that TE class or subfamily 
    run_camera <- function(contrast_name, l2fc_df) {
      camera(
        y = voom_objs$voom_out,
        index = idx,
        design = voom_objs$design,
        contrast = contrast_matrix[, contrast_name],
        inter.gene.cor = intergene_cor
      ) %>%
        rownames_to_column(group_var) %>%
        left_join(., l2fc_df, by = group_var) %>%
        mutate(cell_line = cell_line, comparison = contrast_name)
    }
    
    # Bind the Ctrl and DP outputs of the camera function together and return 
    camera_outs <- bind_rows(
      camera_outs,
      run_camera("WT_vs_KO_CTRL", l2fc$ctrl),
      run_camera("WT_vs_KO_DP",   l2fc$dp)
    )
  }
  
  camera_outs %>%
    mutate(
      log10FDR = -log10(FDR),
      is_significant = case_when(FDR < 0.05 ~ "Significant", TRUE ~ "Non-significant"),
      comp_rename = str_replace_all(comparison, "_", " ")
    )
}

# Run for both grouping levels
camera_outs_subfam <- run_camera_loop_wtko(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var = "TE_subfamily", intergene_cor = 0.1)
camera_outs_class  <- run_camera_loop_wtko(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var = "TE_class", intergene_cor = 0.1)
```

### Figure 3B/C: TE versus canonical promoter usage in WT & KO Trt v. Ctrl, split by TE class

```{r, Figures 3B-C, echo = FALSE}
###################################################################################################################################
# Look at genes that have both canonical and TE-derived quantification and look for the ratio of expression in WT versus KO samples
###################################################################################################################################
###################
# Data generation #
###################
dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
A549_dds <- dds_objs[[1]][[1]]
RKO_dds <- dds_objs[[3]][[1]]
HCT116_dds <- dds_objs[[2]][[1]]
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sub <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, gene_name, TE_class)

# First, plot the expression of TE-derived and canonical genes in each of the individual samples as an effect of epitherapy (i.e. the log2FC of TE versus the log2FC of canonical)
plot_dual_promoter_genes <- function(dds, dds_name){
  # dds <- A549_dds
  # dds_name <- "A549"
  ko <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "KO_DP", "KO_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>% 
          as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
          # Join witih the TE annotation and then remove dups 
          left_join(te_anno_sub) %>% distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
          # Make a column containing the canonical gene name of TE-derived genes 
          mutate(adj_gene_name = case_when(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name ~ gene_name, TRUE ~ teprof3_gene_name)) %>% 
          # Filter for instances with only two transcripts, the canonical and the TE-derived
          add_count(adj_gene_name) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% group_by(adj_gene_name) %>% 
          # Count how many teprof3_gene_name values in the group are in te_anno_sub (to filter for instances with 2 TE-derived transcripts )
          filter(sum(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name) < 2) %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(-n) %>% 
          # Fill the TE class column for coloring the plot then pivot
          mutate(is_te = case_when(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name ~ "TE", TRUE ~ "Canonical")) %>% group_by(adj_gene_name) %>% fill(TE_class, .direction = "downup") %>%
          pivot_wider(id_cols = c(adj_gene_name, TE_class), names_from = is_te, values_from = log2FoldChange) %>% 
          # Add p53 and cell information for the output data frame
          mutate(p53 = "KO", cell = dds_name)
  
    wt <- lfcShrink(dds = dds, contrast = c("group", "WT_DP", "WT_CTRL"), type = "ashr") %>% 
          as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
          left_join(te_anno_sub) %>% distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
          mutate(adj_gene_name = case_when(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name ~ gene_name, TRUE ~ teprof3_gene_name)) %>% 
          add_count(adj_gene_name) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% group_by(adj_gene_name) %>% 
          filter(sum(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name) < 2) %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(-n) %>% 
          mutate(is_te = case_when(teprof3_gene_name %in% te_anno_sub$teprof3_gene_name ~ "TE", TRUE ~ "Canonical")) %>% group_by(adj_gene_name) %>% fill(TE_class, .direction = "downup") %>%
          pivot_wider(id_cols = c(adj_gene_name, TE_class), names_from = is_te, values_from = log2FoldChange) %>% 
          mutate(p53 = "WT", cell = dds_name)
    
    res <- bind_rows(ko, wt)
    return(res)
}
res_df1 <- map2_dfr(list(A549_dds, RKO_dds, HCT116_dds), list("A549", "RKO", "HCT116"), plot_dual_promoter_genes) %>% filter(TE_class %in% c("DNA", "LINE", "LTR", "SINE"))
# Separate the KO and WT values into two data frames 
ko_res <- res_df1 %>% filter(p53 == "KO")
wt_res <- res_df1 %>% filter(p53 == "WT")

############
# Plotting #
############
cell_color_mapping <- c('A549' = "#62b045", 'HCT116' = "#b13ba7", 'RKO' = "#b7b247")

ko_p <- ggplot(ko_res, aes(x = Canonical, y = TE)) + geom_point(aes(color = TE_class), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
          facet_grid2(rows = vars(TE_class), 
                      cols = vars(cell), 
                      strip = strip_themed(
                        text_y = elem_list_text(color = "white", size  = 11, face = "bold"),
                        background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = te_color_mapping[levels(factor(ko_res$TE_class))]),
                        text_x = elem_list_text(color = "white", size = 11, face = "bold"), 
                        background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = cell_color_mapping[levels(factor(ko_res$cell))]))
                      ) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c(c("LINE" = "#FF8E56","SINE" = "#DB544D","LTR" = "#528C4C","DNA" = "#7896EE")), name = "TE Class") + 
          labs(title = "TE Expression/Canonical Expression\nof genes, KO p53 Trt v. Ctrl",  x = expression(paste("Canonical log"[2], "FC")), y = expression(paste("TE log"[2], "FC"))) +
          geom_abline() + theme_pubr(legend = "right") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

wt_p <- ggplot(wt_res, aes(x = Canonical, y = TE)) + geom_point(aes(color = TE_class), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
          facet_grid2(rows = vars(TE_class), 
                      cols = vars(cell), 
                      strip = strip_themed(
                        text_y = elem_list_text(color = "white", size  = 11, face = "bold"),
                        background_y = elem_list_rect(fill = te_color_mapping[levels(factor(wt_res$TE_class))]),
                        text_x = elem_list_text(color = "white", size = 11, face = "bold"), 
                        background_x = elem_list_rect(fill = cell_color_mapping[levels(factor(wt_res$cell))]))
                      ) +
          scale_color_manual(values = c(c("LINE" = "#FF8E56","SINE" = "#DB544D","LTR" = "#528C4C","DNA" = "#7896EE")), name = "TE Class") + 
          labs(title = "TE Expression/Canonical Expression\nof genes, WT p53 Trt v. Ctrl", x = expression(paste("Canonical log"[2], "FC"))) +
          geom_abline() + theme_pubr(legend = "right") + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none", axis.title.y = element_blank())

te_canonical_expression_ko_wt <- wrap_plots(ko_p, wt_p)
```

### fgsea of ERV1s to confirm shift
```{r}
dds_objs <- list.files(sprintf("%s/rna/", rds_path), pattern = "KO_WT_deseq2_20260105.rds", full.names = TRUE) %>% lapply(., readRDS)
A549_dds <- dds_objs[[1]][[1]]
RKO_dds <- dds_objs[[3]][[1]]
HCT116_dds <- dds_objs[[2]][[1]]
te_anno <- read_delim(file = sprintf("%s/teprof3_output_filter_transcript_TE_transcript_consensus.tsv", assembly_dir), delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
te_anno_sub <- te_anno %>% dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, gene_name, TE_class)

run_fgsea_loop_wtko <- function(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var) {
  # Index of DESeq2 result objects: [[3]] = WT_vs_KO_CTRL, [[5]] = WT_vs_KO_DP
  res_idx <- list(ctrl = 3, dp = 5)
  comparisons <- list(ctrl = "WT_vs_KO_CTRL", dp = "WT_vs_KO_DP")
  
  fgsea_outs <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in seq_along(dds_objs)) {
    dds_obj <- dds_objs[[i]][[1]]
    cell_line <- dds_obj@colData$Cell %>% unique()
    
    # Compute mean log2FC for each contrast (unchanged — same helper as camera version)
    l2fc <- list(
      ctrl = get_mean_l2fc(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$ctrl]], te_anno_sel, group_var),
      dp   = get_mean_l2fc(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$dp]],   te_anno_sel, group_var)
    )
    
    # Build gene sets at the specified grouping level
    te_anno_counts <- dds_obj %>%
      counts(normalized = TRUE) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>%
      left_join(., te_anno_sel, by = "teprof3_gene_name") %>%
      drop_na() %>%
      distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, all_of(group_var))
    
    gene_sets <- split(te_anno_counts$teprof3_gene_name, te_anno_counts[[group_var]])
    filtered_gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) > 1]
    
    # Run fgsea for each contrast using its own ranked vector
    run_fgsea_contrast <- function(deseq_res, l2fc_df, contrast_name) {
      # Build ranked vector directly from the DESeq2 results object
      res_df <- deseq_res %>% as.data.frame()
      rl <- res_df$log2FoldChange
      names(rl) <- rownames(res_df)
      rl <- rl[!is.na(rl)]
      rankings <- sort(rl, decreasing = TRUE)
      
      fgsea::fgsea(pathways = filtered_gene_sets, stats = rankings) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rename(!!group_var := pathway) %>%
        left_join(., l2fc_df, by = group_var) %>%
        mutate(cell_line = cell_line, comparison = contrast_name)
    }
    
    fgsea_outs <- bind_rows(
      fgsea_outs,
      run_fgsea_contrast(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$ctrl]], l2fc$ctrl, "WT_vs_KO_CTRL"),
      run_fgsea_contrast(dds_objs[[i]][[res_idx$dp]],   l2fc$dp,   "WT_vs_KO_DP")
    )
  }
  
  fgsea_outs %>%
    mutate(
      log10FDR = -log10(padj),
      is_significant = case_when(padj < 0.05 ~ "Significant", TRUE ~ "Non-significant"),
      comp_rename = str_replace_all(comparison, "_", " ")
    )
}

# Run for both grouping levels
fgsea_outs_subfam <- run_fgsea_loop_wtko(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var = "TE_subfamily")
fgsea_outs_class  <- run_fgsea_loop_wtko(dds_objs, te_anno_sel, group_var = "TE_class")

# Add TE class annotation to subfamily results
te_anno_class <- te_anno_sel %>%
  dplyr::select(TE_class, TE_subfamily) %>%
  distinct(TE_subfamily, .keep_all = TRUE)
fgsea_outs_subfam <- left_join(fgsea_outs_subfam, te_anno_class, by = "TE_subfamily")
```

### Design primers for qPCR to assess TE versus chimeric expression 
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

seqs <- readDNAStringSet("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/tx_to_seq/TE_transcripts.fa")
names(seqs) <- sub("::.*", "", names(seqs))

keep_gene <- c("LTR12C-R3HCC1", "LTR12C-TNFRSF10B", "LTR12C-HSD17B11", "MER61C-PURPL")
keep_gene_2 <- c("LTR12C-C1S", "LTR12C-CGREF1", "LTR12C-NPC1", "LTR12C-CCR4")

jn <- read_tsv("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/tx_to_seq/junctions.tsv", col_names = c("id", "strand", "len", "n_exons", "junctions"),
               col_types = "ccdic") %>%
  filter(id %in% names(seqs)) %>%
  mutate(tu = sub("\\|.*", "", id), gene = sub("^[^|]*\\|", "", id)) %>%
  filter(gene %in% keep_gene_2) %>%
  dplyr::select(-tu, -gene)

cuts <- lapply(strsplit(replace(jn$junctions, is.na(jn$junctions), ""), ","), as.integer)

fmt_seq <- function(s) {
  s <- tolower(s); n <- nchar(s)
  vapply(seq(1, n, by = 60), function(st) {
    chunk <- substring(s, st, min(st + 59, n))
    m <- nchar(chunk)
    blocks <- substring(chunk, seq(1, m, 10), pmin(seq(10, m + 9, 10), m))
    sprintf("%9d %s", st, paste(blocks, collapse = " "))
  }, character(1))
}

write_gb <- function(tu, gene, strand, s, cu, file) {
  n    <- nchar(s)
  ex   <- Map(function(i) c(cu[i] + 1, cu[i + 1]), seq_len(length(cu) - 1))
  feat <- unlist(Map(function(e, i) c(
    sprintf("     exon            %d..%d", e[1], e[2]),
    sprintf("                     /label=\"Exon %d\"", i),
    sprintf("                     /number=%d", i)), ex, seq_along(ex)))
  writeLines(c(
    sprintf("LOCUS       %-16s %d bp    mRNA    linear   UNK 01-JAN-1980", substr(tu, 1, 16), n),
    sprintf("DEFINITION  %s (genomic strand %s).", gene, strand),
    "FEATURES             Location/Qualifiers",
    feat, "ORIGIN", fmt_seq(s), "//"), file)
}

out_dir <- "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/tx_to_seq/snapgene"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(jn))) {
  parts <- strsplit(jn$id[k], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  tu <- parts[1]; gene <- parts[2]
  cu <- c(0L, cuts[[k]], jn$len[k])
  fname <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", paste(tu, gene, sep = "_")), ".gb")
  write_gb(tu, gene, jn$strand[k], as.character(seqs[[jn$id[k]]]), cu, file.path(out_dir, fname))
}
```

```{r}
# Read in the Kimura age file from Xiaoyu
ka <- read_csv(sprintf("%s/kimura_distance_age_hg38.csv", outputs_path))
# 20261029: There is a mapping issue that was created because of the inclusion of 5' and 3' ends of LINEs. Xiaoyu suggested using the 3' end since it should be more neutral is accumulation of mutations and give a more accurate age estimate
# Drop the rows the _5end suffix and rename the _3end rows 
ka_corr <- ka %>% mutate(
            base_name = str_remove(Repeat, regex("_(5end|3end|orf\\d*)$", ignore_case = TRUE)),
            # Create a ranking system that prefers 3' end > 5' end > ORF
            rank = case_when(
              str_detect(Repeat, regex("_3end$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ 1, 
              str_detect(Repeat, regex("_5end$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ 2,
              str_detect(Repeat, regex("_orf\\d*$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ 3,
              TRUE ~ 1 
            )
          ) %>%
          group_by(base_name) %>%
          arrange(rank, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
          dplyr::slice(1) %>% 
          ungroup() %>%
          mutate(Repeat = base_name) %>%
```

### Figures S5A-B: LTR enrichment in WT v. KO DARs

```{r, Supplemental Figures 5A-B, echo = FALSE}
summit_te_dir <- "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/ATAC/bam/idr/TE_overlap"
file_list <- list.files(summit_te_dir, full.names = TRUE)
# For each file, calculate the enrichment of each subfamily using the following formula

# Load in the repeatmasker annotation data
rmsk <- read.delim(file = "/scratch/devtools/cmccornack/genomes/hg38.rmsk", sep = "\t")
# Calculate the length of each individual element
rmsk$length <- rmsk$genoEnd - rmsk$genoStart
# Make a dataframe of the counts of these TE subfamilies filtering for TEs that have a count of at least 30
rmsk_subfam_count <- rmsk %>% filter(repClass %in% c("DNA", "LINE", "LTR", "SINE")) %>% group_by(repName) %>% dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% filter(count > 30)
te_subfam_anno <- rmsk %>% filter(repName %in% rmsk_subfam_count$repName) %>% dplyr::select(repName, repClass, repFamily) %>% distinct(repName, .keep_all = TRUE)
colnames(te_subfam_anno) <- c("TE_subfamily", "TE_Class", "TE_Family")
# Calculate the total length covered by TEs
filt_rmsk <- rmsk %>% filter(repName %in% rmsk_subfam_count$repName)
total_length <- sum(filt_rmsk$length)
# Make a data frame that contains the subfamily names and their total length in the genome
rmsk_subfam_length <- rmsk %>% filter(repName %in% rmsk_subfam_count$repName) %>% group_by(repName) %>% dplyr::summarize(total_length = sum(length))

calc_enrichment <- function(summit_te_file){
  # summit_te_file <- file_list[1]
  # Read in the TE summit file (file of TEs that overlap DAR peak summits)
  df <- read_delim(summit_te_file, col_names = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "te_subfamily", "te_class", "te_family")) %>%
    # Filter for classes of interest
    filter(te_class %in% c("DNA", "LINE", "LTR", "SINE"))
  # Make a data frame enumerating the totals of each subfamily overlapping a DAR peak, filtering for those that have >10 observed peaks
  sample_subfam_count <- df %>% group_by(te_subfamily) %>% dplyr::summarise(count = n()) %>% filter(count > 10)
  # Make a vector containing the subfamily information
  subfams <- sample_subfam_count$te_subfamily %>% unique
  # Make an empty data frame to hold the outputs
  subfam_logOdds <- data.frame(TE_subfamily = character(), log2Odds = numeric(), observed_count = integer(), TE_subfamily_count = integer())
  for(i in seq_along(subfams)){
    # Select a subfamily
    subfam <- subfams[i]
    # Make the numerator, a quotient of the counts observed of this subfamily and the length of that TE subfamily
    obs_ct <- sample_subfam_count %>% filter(te_subfamily == subfam) %>% pull(count)
    subfam_length <- rmsk_subfam_length %>% filter(repName == subfam) %>% pull(total_length)
    numerator <- obs_ct / subfam_length
    # Make the denominator, a quotient of the total counts in the genome and the total length covered by TEs
    subfam_count <- rmsk_subfam_count %>% filter(repName == subfam) %>% pull(count)
    denominator <- subfam_count / total_length
    # Calculate the log2 of this quotient and append this to the output data frame
    temp_df <- data.frame(TE_subfamily = subfam, log2Odds = log2(numerator/denominator), observed_count = obs_ct, TE_subfamily_count = subfam_count)
    subfam_logOdds <- bind_rows(subfam_logOdds, temp_df)
  }
  # Append columns containing other TE information and the sample name of the calculated log2Odds
  subfam_logOdds <- subfam_logOdds %>% mutate(sample = basename(summit_te_file) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 1)) %>% left_join(., te_subfam_anno)
  return(subfam_logOdds)
}

# Using the enrichment results, create XY plots showing the comparative enrichment in treated v. untreated and WT v. KO samples

  left_join(., te_subfam_anno) %>% mutate(cell = str_split_i(sample, "_", 1), p53 = str_split_i(sample, "_", 2), treatment = str_split_i(sample, "_", 3))

cell_colors <- c('A549' = "#62b045", 'HCT116' = "#b13ba7", 'RKO' = "#b7b247")

# Helper function to prepare data frames in wide format  
prepare_wide_data_wtko <- function(filt_df, te_class, treatment) {
  # Check which treatment is being done (DP or Ctrl) to make a plot title 
  file_title <- if (treatment == "DP") {
    paste0("DP_WTvKO_", te_class, "_Enrichment")
  } else {
    paste0("CTRL_WTvKO_", te_class, "_Enrichment")
  }
  # Concatenate the sample label from the generated file title 
  sample_label <- str_c(str_split_i(file_title, "_", 1),
                         str_split_i(file_title, "_", 2),
                         str_split_i(file_title, "_", 3), sep = "_")
  # Filter the data frame for the treatment comparison and TE class of interest
  filt_df %>%
    filter(treatment == !!treatment, TE_Class == te_class) %>%
    arrange(TE_subfamily) %>%
    dplyr::select(TE_subfamily, cell, p53, log2Odds) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = p53, values_from = log2Odds) %>%
    # Remove rows where both enrichment values are <1.5 (~3-fold change)
    filter(!(KO < 1.5 & WT < 1.5)) %>%
    # Add a column containing the ratio of the log2Odds enrichment 
    mutate(ratio = (WT + 0.01) / (KO + 0.01)) %>%
    # Arrange by the ratio order 
    arrange(desc(ratio)) %>% 
    # Mutate on row labels and ranks 
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      label = if_else(rank <= 10, TE_subfamily, ""),
      sample_label = sample_label
    )
}

# Helpr function to make xy plots 
make_xy_plot_wtko <- function(wide_data, plot_title) {
  # Pull the max value for plotting and set the axis limits accordingly 
  max_limit <- c(wide_data$KO, wide_data$WT) %>% max(na.rm = TRUE) %>% ceiling()

  ggplot(wide_data, aes(x = KO, y = WT, color = cell)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = label),
                  size = 5,
                  max.overlaps = 20,
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.5,
                  min.segment.length = 0.5,
                  segment.color = "gray50",
                  segment.alpha = 0.6,
                  force = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
    xlim(0, max_limit) + ylim(0, max_limit) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = plot_title) +
    theme_pubr(legend = "right") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cell_colors)
}

# Plotting function the use the helper functions to make the xy plots 
plot_te_enrichment <- function(filt_df, te_class, treatment, 
                                plots_path, save_pdf = FALSE) {
  # Make the title 
  treatment_label <- if (treatment == "DP") "DP" else "CTRL"
  plot_title <- sprintf("%s WT v. KO\n%s Enrichment", treatment_label, te_class)
  file_title <- sprintf("%s_WTvKO_%s_Enrichment", treatment_label, te_class)

  # Use the helper functions to make the wide data and scatter plot 
  wide_data <- prepare_wide_data_wtko(filt_df, te_class, treatment)
  p <- make_xy_plot_wtko(wide_data, plot_title)

  # Optionally save to pdf 
  if (save_pdf) {
    pdf(file = sprintf("%s/atac/%s.pdf", plots_path, file_title), width = 6, height = 6)
    print(p)
    dev.off()
  }

  # Return the data frame and plot as a list object 
  list(wide_data = wide_data, plot = p)
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Helper function for plotting 
create_density_plot <- function(data, title, color_var = NULL) {
  if (is.null(color_var)) {
    # Plot without color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc)) +
      geom_density(fill = "white", alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
  } else {
    # Plot with color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
      geom_density(fill = NA)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.1, 0.9), linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, x = "TE Percent", y = "Density") +
    common_theme() +
    xlim(0, 1)
  
  if (!is.null(color_var)) {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = te_colors, name = "TE Type")
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```
