```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Recoded as functions 
# Helper function to compute mean log2FC at a given grouping level
get_mean_l2fc <- function(dds_res, te_anno_sel, group_var) {
  dds_res %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>% 
    left_join(., te_anno_sel, by = "teprof3_gene_name") %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_var))) %>%
    summarise(mean_log2FC = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Helper function to build voom objects with the correct model matrix
build_voom <- function(dds_obj) {
  expr_mat <- dds_obj %>% counts(normalized = FALSE)
  dge <- DGEList(counts = expr_mat) %>% calcNormFactors()
  sample_names <- colnames(expr_mat)
  condition <- factor(
    paste(str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 1), str_split_i(sample_names, "_", 2), sep = "_"),
    levels = c("KO_Ctrl", "KO_DP", "WT_Ctrl", "WT_DP")
  )
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + condition)
  colnames(design) <- levels(condition)
  voom_out <- voom(dge, design, plot = TRUE)
  list(voom_out = voom_out, design = design, expr_mat = expr_mat)
}

# Function to iterate the camera function over a loop of cell lines and pairwise comparisons
run_camera_loop_wtko <- function(dds_obj, te_anno_sel, group_var, intergene_cor) {
  # Index of DESeq2 result objects: [[3]] = WT_vs_KO_CTRL, [[5]] = WT_vs_KO_DP
  res_idx <- list(ctrl = 3, dp = 5)
  comparisons <- list(ctrl = "WT_vs_KO_Ctrl", dp = "WT_vs_KO_DP")
  
  # Instantiate a data frame to hold the outputs 
  camera_outs <- data.frame()
  
  # dds_obj <- comp_obj[[1]]
  
  # Compute mean log2FC for each contrast at the level of TE classes or subfamilies using the helper function for the background color in the dotplot 
  l2fc <- list(
    ctrl = get_mean_l2fc(comp_obj[[res_idx$ctrl]], te_anno_sel, group_var),
    dp   = get_mean_l2fc(comp_obj[[res_idx$dp]],   te_anno_sel, group_var)
  )
  
  # Build voom and design objects using the helper function 
  voom_objs <- build_voom(dds_obj)
  
  # Build gene sets at the specified grouping level
  te_anno_counts <- dds_obj %>%
    counts(normalized = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("teprof3_gene_name") %>%
    left_join(., te_anno_sel, by = "teprof3_gene_name") %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    distinct(teprof3_gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(teprof3_gene_name, all_of(group_var))
  
  gene_sets <- split(te_anno_counts$teprof3_gene_name, te_anno_counts[[group_var]])
  filtered_gene_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) > 1]
  idx <- ids2indices(filtered_gene_sets, identifiers = rownames(voom_objs$expr_mat))
  
  # Build contrast matrix
  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
    WT_vs_KO_Ctrl = WT_Ctrl - KO_Ctrl,
    WT_vs_KO_DP   = WT_DP   - KO_DP,
    levels = voom_objs$design
  )
  
  # Run camera for each contrast and join mean log2FC information for that TE class or subfamily 
  run_camera <- function(contrast_name, l2fc_df) {
    camera(
      y = voom_objs$voom_out,
      index = idx,
      design = voom_objs$design,
      contrast = contrast_matrix[, contrast_name],
      inter.gene.cor = intergene_cor
    ) %>%
      rownames_to_column(group_var) %>%
      left_join(., l2fc_df, by = group_var) %>%
      mutate(comparison = contrast_name)
  }
  
  # Bind the Ctrl and DP outputs of the camera function together and return 
  camera_outs <- bind_rows(
    camera_outs,
    run_camera("WT_vs_KO_Ctrl", l2fc$ctrl),
    run_camera("WT_vs_KO_DP",   l2fc$dp)
  )
  
  camera_outs %>%
    mutate(
      log10FDR = -log10(FDR),
      is_significant = case_when(FDR < 0.05 ~ "Significant", TRUE ~ "Non-significant"),
      comp_rename = str_replace_all(comparison, "_", " ")
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Make a common plot theme and define the TE colors 
common_theme <- function() {theme_pubr() + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10), legend.position = "right", legend.justification = "center")}
te_colors <- c("LINE" = "#FF8E56", "SINE" = "#DB544D", "LTR" = "#528C4C", "DNA" = "#7896EE")

# Helper function for plotting 
create_density_plot <- function(data, title, color_var = NULL) {
  if (is.null(color_var)) {
    # Plot without color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc)) +
      geom_density(fill = "white", alpha = 0.5, color = "black")
  } else {
    # Plot with color aesthetic
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = TE_down_perc, color = .data[[color_var]])) +
      geom_density(fill = NA)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(0.1, 0.9), linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, x = "TE Percent", y = "Density") +
    common_theme() +
    xlim(0, 1)
  
  if (!is.null(color_var)) {
    p <- p + scale_color_manual(values = te_colors, name = "TE Type")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

run_competitive_enrichment <- function(
    dds_obj,
    gene_sets,
    condition_col,
    comparisons,
    intergene_cor = 0.1,
    min_set_size = 2,
    set_name_default = "gene_set_of_interest"
) {
  # make sure the input object is a DDS object
  if (!is(dds_obj, "DESeqDataSet")) {
    stop("dds_obj must be a DESeqDataSet object")
  }
  # Make sure the condition is in the colData of the object 
  if (!condition_col %in% colnames(colData(dds_obj))) {
    stop(sprintf("'%s' not found in colData", condition_col))
  }
  # gene_sets = by_class
  # dds_obj = dds
  # condition_col = "Mut"
  # intergene_cor = 0.1
  # min_set_size = 2
  # set_name_default = "gene_set_of_interest"
  # Normalize gene_sets input
  gene_sets <- .normalize_gene_sets(gene_sets, set_name_default)
  
  # Build voom object
  voom_result <- .build_voom(dds_obj, condition_col)
  
  # filter gene sets by min size
  filtered_sets <- gene_sets[sapply(gene_sets, length) >= min_set_size]
  if (length(filtered_sets) == 0) {
    warning("No gene sets meet min_set_size after filtering for this object. Skipping.")
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  idx <- ids2indices(filtered_sets, identifiers = rownames(voom_result$expr_mat))
  
  # Run the comparisons
  results_list <- map(names(comparisons), function(comp_name) {
    tryCatch({
      .process_comparison(
        comp_name     = comp_name,
        comp_config   = comparisons[[comp_name]],
        dds_obj       = dds_obj,
        voom_result   = voom_result,
        idx           = idx,
        gene_sets     = filtered_sets,
        intergene_cor = intergene_cor
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Identify the failing cell line context safely
      cell_line_info <- tryCatch(unique(colData(dds_obj)$Cell), error = function(...) "Unknown")
      
      # Downgrade error to a structural warning
      warning(
        sprintf("Skipping '%s' for cell line '%s' due to error: %s", 
                comp_name, cell_line_info, e$message), 
        call. = FALSE
      )
      return(NULL) # Return NULL so it can be discarded safely
    })
  })
  
  # Filter out failed comparison blocks (NULLs)
  results_list <- compact(results_list)
  
  # Guard against completely empty sets before executing dplyr operations
  if (length(results_list) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  combined_results <- bind_rows(results_list)
  
  # Final Guard: Ensure camera returned actual rows and an FDR column
  if (nrow(combined_results) == 0 || !"FDR" %in% colnames(combined_results)) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  combined_results %>%
    mutate(
      log10FDR = -log10(FDR),
      is_significant = if_else(FDR < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant"),
      comparison_label = str_replace_all(comparison, "_", " ")
    )
}

#' Normalize gene_sets input to a named list
#' @keywords internal
.normalize_gene_sets <- function(gene_sets, set_name_default) {
  if (is.character(gene_sets) && is.null(names(gene_sets))) {
    # Single unnamed character vector -> wrap in a named list
    return(setNames(list(gene_sets), set_name_default))
  }
  if (is.list(gene_sets)) {
    if (is.null(names(gene_sets)) || any(names(gene_sets) == "")) {
      stop("gene_sets list must be fully named")
    }
    return(gene_sets)
  }
  stop("gene_sets must be a character vector or a named list of character vectors")
}

#' Build voom object from DESeq2 counts
#' @keywords internal
.build_voom <- function(dds_obj, condition_col) {
  expr_mat <- counts(dds_obj, normalized = FALSE)
  dge <- DGEList(counts = expr_mat) %>% calcNormFactors()
  
  condition <- factor(colData(dds_obj)[[condition_col]])
  design <- model.matrix(~0 + condition)
  colnames(design) <- levels(condition)
  
  voom_out <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
  
  list(voom_out = voom_out, design = design, expr_mat = expr_mat)
}

#' Process a single comparison: run camera + compute mean log2FC per set
#' @keywords internal
.process_comparison <- function(
    comp_name, comp_config, dds_obj, voom_result, idx, gene_sets, intergene_cor
) {
  
  if (is.null(comp_config$formula)) {
    stop(sprintf("Comparison '%s' must specify a 'formula' for makeContrasts", comp_name))
  }
  
  # Build contrast matrix for camera using the formula string directly
  contrast_matrix <- limma::makeContrasts(
    contrasts = comp_config$formula,
    levels = voom_result$design
  )
  
  # Get DESeq2 results object for mean log2FC calculation (separate from camera contrast)
  deseq_res <- .get_comparison_results(dds_obj, comp_config)
  mean_l2fc <- .calculate_mean_l2fc_from_sets(deseq_res, gene_sets)
  
  camera(
    y = voom_result$voom_out,
    index = idx,
    design = voom_result$design,
    contrast = contrast_matrix,
    inter.gene.cor = intergene_cor
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("set_name") %>%
    left_join(mean_l2fc, by = "set_name") %>%
    mutate(
      comparison = comp_name,
      cell_line = unique(colData(dds_obj)$Cell),
      direction = if_else(Direction == "Up", "Enriched", "Depleted")
    )
}

#' Get DESeq2 results for a specific comparison (used only for mean log2FC)
#' @keywords internal
.get_comparison_results <- function(dds_obj, comp_config) {
  if (!is.null(comp_config$res_obj)) {
    comp_config$res_obj
  } else if (!is.null(comp_config$name)) {
    results(dds_obj, name = comp_config$name)
  } else if (!is.null(comp_config$contrast)) {
    results(dds_obj, contrast = comp_config$contrast)
  } else {
    stop("Comparison must specify 'res_obj', 'name', or 'contrast' for mean log2FC calculation")
  }
}

#' Calculate mean log2FC per gene set directly from set membership
#' (no annotation join required — sets are defined by the gene_sets list itself)
#' @keywords internal
.calculate_mean_l2fc_from_sets <- function(deseq_res, gene_sets) {
  res_df <- as.data.frame(deseq_res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_id")
  
  map_dfr(names(gene_sets), function(set_name) {
    genes_in_set <- gene_sets[[set_name]]
    sub <- res_df %>% filter(gene_id %in% genes_in_set)
    tibble(
      set_name    = set_name,
      mean_log2FC = mean(sub$log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_genes     = nrow(sub)
    )
  })
}

# Helper function to build each plot with shared scale calculated above
make_te_dotplot <- function(data, color_mapping) {
  min_l2fc <- data$mean_log2FC %>% min()
  max_l2fc <- data$mean_log2FC %>% max()
  max_fdr <- data$log10FDR %>% max()
  
  set_to_class <- data %>% 
    distinct(set_name, TE_class) %>% 
    deframe()
  
  n_class <- length(unique(data$TE_class))
  n_set   <- length(unique(data$set_name))
  
  facet_colors <- color_mapping[set_to_class[levels(factor(data$set_name))]]
  names(facet_colors) <- levels(factor(data$set_name))
  
  ggplot(data, aes(y = factor(comparison), x = factor(cell_line))) + 
    geom_tile(aes(fill = mean_log2FC)) + 
    geom_point(aes(size = log10FDR, color = is_significant)) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "blue", high = "red",
      limits = c(min_l2fc, max_l2fc),
      name = "Mean log2FC"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(2, 6),
      limits = c(0, max_fdr),
      breaks = seq(0, max_fdr, length.out = 4) %>% round,
      name = "-log10(FDR)"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Significant" = "black", "Non-significant" = NA),
      name = "Significance",
      labels = c("Significant" = "FDR < 0.05", "Non-significant" = "FDR ≥ 0.05")
    ) + 
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4), order = 1),
      size  = guide_legend(order = 2),
      fill  = guide_colorbar(order = 3)
    ) + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(), 
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) + 
    ggh4x::facet_nested(
      cols = vars(TE_class, set_name),
      scales = "free",
      space = "free",
      nest_line = element_line(color = "black"),
      strip = strip_nested(
        text_y = elem_list_text(color = "white", size = 11, face = "bold"),
        # Flat list: first n_class elements = outer strip colors, 
        # next n_set elements = inner strip colors (grey)
        background_x = elem_list_rect(
          fill = c(color_mapping[levels(factor(data$TE_class))], 
                   rep("grey90", n_set))
        ),
        text_x = elem_list_text(
          color = c(rep("white", n_class), rep("black", n_set)),
          size  = c(rep(11, n_class), rep(8, n_set)),
          face  = c(rep("bold", n_class), rep("plain", n_set))
        )
      )
    )
}

# Build all three with identical scales
```

```{r, Figure 4A, echo = FALSE}
get_metadata_summary <- function(seurat_obj, 
                                 metadata_cols = NULL, 
                                 include_sd = FALSE,
                                 include_n = FALSE) {
  
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj[[]]
  
  # Ensure orig.ident exists
  if (!"orig.ident" %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    metadata$orig.ident <- seurat_obj$orig.ident
  }
  
  # Select columns to summarize
  if (is.null(metadata_cols)) {
    # Automatically select numeric columns
    cols_to_summarize <- metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(-orig.ident) %>%
      dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
      colnames()
  } else {
    cols_to_summarize <- metadata_cols
  }
  
  # Build summary list
  summary_funs <- list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 
                       median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (include_sd) {
    summary_funs$sd <- ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (include_n) {
    summary_funs$n = ~sum(!is.na(.))
  }
  
  # Calculate statistics
  summary_stats <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::group_by(orig.ident) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cols_to_summarize), 
                                   summary_funs,
                                   .names = "{col}_{fn}"),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -orig.ident,
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(metric, 
                    into = c("column", "statistic"),
                    sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = orig.ident,
      values_from = value
    )
  
  summary_stats
}
md_sum <- get_metadata_summary(flt_obj, include_sd = TRUE, include_n = TRUE)
write_csv(md_sum, file = sprintf("%s/scrna/metadata_summary.csv", outputs_path))


get_cluster_summary <- function(seurat_obj, 
                                cluster_col = "RNA_snn_res1.2",  # Specify cluster column
                                metadata_cols = NULL, 
                                include_sd = FALSE,
                                include_n = FALSE) {
  
  # Extract metadata
  metadata <- seurat_obj[[]]
  
  # Check if cluster column exists
  if (!cluster_col %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    stop(paste("Column", cluster_col, "not found in metadata. Available columns:", 
               paste(colnames(metadata), collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Rename cluster column to "cluster" for easier handling
  metadata$cluster <- metadata[[cluster_col]]
  
  # Select columns to summarize
  if (is.null(metadata_cols)) {
    # Automatically select numeric columns (excluding cluster column)
    cols_to_summarize <- metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(-cluster, -dplyr::any_of(cluster_col)) %>%
      dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
      colnames()
  } else {
    cols_to_summarize <- metadata_cols
  }
  
  # Build summary list
  summary_funs <- list(mean = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE), 
                       median = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE))
  
  if (include_sd) {
    summary_funs$sd <- ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (include_n) {
    summary_funs$n = ~sum(!is.na(.))
  }
  
  # Calculate statistics grouped by cluster
  summary_stats <- metadata %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cols_to_summarize), 
                                   summary_funs,
                                   .names = "{col}_{fn}"),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -cluster,
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate(metric, 
                    into = c("column", "statistic"),
                    sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = cluster,
      values_from = value
    )
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Usage
md_sum <- get_cluster_summary(flt_obj, 
                              cluster_col = "RNA_snn_res.1.2", 
                              include_sd = TRUE, 
                              include_n = TRUE)

write_csv(md_sum, file = sprintf("%s/scrna/metadata_summary_cluster.csv", outputs_path))
```

```{r, Figure 4H, echo = FALSE}
                        rownames(.) %in% tets ~ "TE-transcript",

                        ), 
                        significance = case_when(
                         -log10(p_val_adj) < 1 | abs(avg_log2FC) < 0.4 ~ 0.05,

                        ),
                       rank = row_number(), 
                       annotation = case_when(
                         !is.na(overlaps) & rank < 100 & avg_log2FC > 0 ~ rownames(.),

                        )

                      size = 3, 
                      max.overlaps = 10, box.padding = 1, point.padding = 1, min.segment.length = 0.1, segment.color = "gray50", segment.alpha = 1, force = 30, force_pull = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
```

```{r, Figures 4J-K, echo = FALSE}
# ac <- AddChromatinModule(ac, features = features, genome = "hg38", assay = "PeakMatrix")
# Break down the AddChromatinModule function so it doesn't require exact region overlaps (from fastmatch)
AddChromatinModule_CM <- function(object, features_grl, genome, assay = NULL, verbose = TRUE, ...) 
{ 
    # object = ac
    # features_grl = te_grl
    assay <- DefaultAssay(object)
    assay.obj <- object[[assay]]
    if (!inherits(assay.obj, "ChromatinAssay")) {
        stop("The requested assay is not a ChromatinAssay.")
      }
    feat.matrix <- GetAssayData(object = assay.obj, layer = "counts")
    num.peaks <- nrow(feat.matrix)
    peak_ranges <- granges(assay.obj)
    feat.idx <- lapply(features_grl, function(x) {
      hits <- findOverlaps(query = peak_ranges, subject = x)
      return(as.integer(unique(queryHits(hits))))
    })
    num_peaks <- as.integer(nrow(object[["PeakMatrix"]]))
    num_modules <- length(features_grl)
    i_idx <- unlist(feat.idx, use.names = FALSE) %>% as.integer
    j_idx <- rep(seq_along(feat.idx), times = sapply(feat.idx, length)) %>% as.integer
    mat <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = i_idx,
    j = j_idx,
    x = 1,
    dims = c(num_peaks, num_modules)
    )
    rownames(x = mat) <- rownames(x = object[["PeakMatrix"]])
    colnames(mat) <- names(features_grl) %||% paste0("Module-", seq_along(features_grl))
    cv <- RunChromVAR(object = assay.obj, motif.matrix = mat, 
        genome = "hg38")
    chromvar.data <- GetAssayData(object = cv, layer = "data")
    object <- AddMetaData(object = object, metadata = as.data.frame(x = t(x = chromvar.data)))
    return(object)
}
```

### Prepare spreadsheets for the GEO upload (single-cell)
```{r, echo = FALSE}
# List the files in the scRNA directory
scrna_fl <- read_csv("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/scrna_filelist.csv", col_names = "filename")
# Extract the individual samples and mutate the columns we need 
scrna_geo_md <- scrna_fl %>% 
                  mutate(library_name = str_split_i(filename, "_R", 1)) %>% 
                  dplyr::select(library_name) %>% 
                  distinct(library_name) %>% 
                # Mutate the metadata information
                  mutate(title = str_replace(library_name, "_", " "), 
                         library_strategy = "scRNA-seq", 
                         organism = "Homo sapiens", 
                         tissue = "", 
                         cell_line = "A549", 
                         cell_type = "lung adenocarcinoma", 
                         genotype = paste0("p53 ", str_split_i(library_name, "_", 1) %>% str_split_i(., "-", 1)), 
                         treatment = case_when(str_detect(library_name, "-T") ~ "300 nM decitabine, 40 nM panobinostat", 
                                        TRUE ~ "DMSO"), 
                         batch = "", 
                         molecule = "total RNA", 
                         single_or_paired_end = "paired-end", 
                         instrument_model = "Illumina NovaSeq 6000", 
                         processed_data_file = "", 
                         raw_file1 = paste0(library_name, "_R1.fastq.gz"), 
                         raw_file2 = paste0(library_name, "_R2.fastq.gz")
                  )
write_csv(scrna_geo_md, "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/scrna_GEO_info.csv")

# Repeat with the scCUT&Tag data 
scct_fl <- read_csv("/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/scct_files.csv")
scct_geo_md <- scct_fl %>% 
                  mutate(library_name = str_split_i(filename, "_R", 1)) %>%

                  distinct(library_name) %>% 
                # Mutate the metadata information
                  mutate(title = str_replace(library_name, "_", " "), 
                         library_strategy = "scCUT&Tag",

                                        TRUE ~ "DMSO"),

                         molecule = "genomic DNA",

                         raw_file1 = paste0(library_name, "_R1.fastq.gz"),

                  )
write_csv(scct_geo_md, "/scratch/cmccornack/epitherapy/20251103_integrative_analysis/scct_GEO_info.csv")
```
